sa: अमर्षेण न चान्योन्यं स्पृहयन्ते कदाचन। न च जातूपतप्यन्ति धीराः परसमृद्धिभिः॥
en: Formerly they never attacked one another, filled with anger. They were all contented and never felt pain on seeing other people's affluence and prosperity,

sa: विननाद महानादं क्षोभयन् दैत्यदानवान्। संनादिता येन लोकाः सर्वाश्चैव दिशो दश॥
en: All the worlds and the ten cardinal points resounded with those roars, which for this reason, agitated all creatures and struck them with fear.

sa: ब्रह्मोवाच वैजयन्तो गिरिवरः सततं सेव्यते मया। अत्रैकाग्रेण मनसा पुरुषश्चिन्त्यते विराट्॥
en: This foremost of mountains, called Vaijayanta, is always my abode. Here, with concentrated mind, I meditate on the one universal Soul of infinite proportions.

sa: तयो भूयो जगत् सर्वं करिष्यामीह विद्यया। अस्मिन् मूर्तिश्चतुर्थी या सासृजज्छेषमव्ययम्॥
en: After the lapse of ages I shall again create the universe, with the help of that Knowledge. My fourth form creates the indestructible Shesha.

sa: रुद्र उवाच त्वत्प्रसादेन भगवन् स्वाध्यायतपसोर्मम। कुशलं चाव्ययं चैव सर्वस्य जगतस्त्वथ॥
en: Rudra said O Illustrious One, through your grace, all is well with my penances and Vedic studies. It is all right, again, with universe.

sa: मनोदृष्टिहरै रम्यैः सर्वतः संवृतं शुभैः। ऋषिभिश्चावृतं तत्र आश्रमं तं मनोहरम्॥
en: Various sorts of beautiful objects, capable of stealing the heart and the eye surrounded that palace. That charming retreat was inhabited by numberless Rishis.

sa: जैगीषव्य उवाच ममाष्टगुणमैश्वर्यं दत्तं भगवता पुरा। यत्नेनान्येन बलिना वाराणस्यां युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Jaigishavya said O Yudhishthira, formerly in the city of Varanasi, the powerful Mahadeva, finding me out, conferred upon me the eight attributes of sovereignty!

sa: इतिहासमिमं पुण्यं मोक्षधर्मोपसंहितम्। धारयेद् यः शमपरः स गच्छेत् परमां गतिम्॥
en: That person devoted to tranquillity who hears this sacred history directly connected with the subject of Liberation is sure to acquire the highest end.

sa: इति जन्म गतिश्चैव शुकस्य भरतर्षभ। विस्तरेण समाख्याता यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि॥
en: I have now told you, O chief of Bharata's race, everything regarding the birth and life of Shukra about which you had asked me.

sa: त्वया कृतेयं मर्यादा लोकसंरक्षणार्थिना। स्थापना वै सुमहती त्वया देव प्रवर्तिता॥
en: Desirous of preserving the worlds, this rule has been laid down by you. It was you, O lord, who had introduced this important rule.

sa: इन्द्रोऽथ धनदो राजा यक्षरक्षोऽधियः सदा। प्रभविष्णुश्च कोशस्य जगतश्च तथा प्रभुः॥
en: The royal Kuvera, the chief of the Yakshas and the Rakshas, is the lord of the wealth of Indra, that master of the universe.

sa: भीष्म उवाच पुरा सोऽन्तर्जलगताः स्थाणुभूतो महाव्रतः। वर्षाणामभवद् राजन् प्रयुतान्यर्बुदानि च॥
en: Bhishma said Then Mahadeva of severe vows, entered the water and remained there like an immovable wooden stake, O king, for millions of years.

sa: त्रिवर्गो यस्य विदितः प्रेक्ष्य यश्च विमुञ्चति। अन्विष्य मनसा युक्तस्तत्त्वदर्शी निरुत्सुकः॥
en: The Soul cannot be seen unless the senses, which are set on various objects and are difficult of being controlled, be all duly restrained.

sa: अत्र मां कैकयीपुत्रः प्रसादयितुमागतः। एषा सा यमुना रम्या दृश्यते चित्रकानना॥
en: There come in view, O you having a beautiful person, the king of mountains, Citrakūta, where to propitiate me, came the son of Kaikey.

sa: तृणमन्तरतः कृत्वा प्रत्युवाच शुचिस्मिता। निवर्तय मनो मत्तः स्वजने प्रीयतां मनः॥
en: Placing a twig before, that one, of beautiful smile, said-"Do you take back your mind from me and place it in your own wives."

sa: किं मामसदृशं वाक्यमीदृशं श्रोत्रदारुणम्। रुक्षं श्रावयसे वीर प्राकृतः प्राकृतामिव ॥
en: Why did you, O hero, like a common man addressing an ordinary woman, make me hear these, harsh and unbecoming words painful to ears?

sa: स तु दृष्ट्वा यमः प्राप्तं महर्षि तत्र नारदम्। अब्रवीत्सुखमासीनमय॑मावेद्य धर्मतः॥
en: Seeing the Maharși Nārada arrive there, Yama offering him arghya according to the ordinance, addressed him saying, when he was seated at his case:

sa: प्राप्तराज्यस्य रामस्य राक्षसानां वधे कृते। आजग्मुर्मुनयः सर्वे राघवं प्रतिनन्दितुम् ॥
en: On the Rākṣasas having been slain, all the ascetics, for the purpose of congratulating Rāghava, came to Rāma as he gained (back) his kingdom.

sa: तद् वनमुपागम्य बभूवुः परमोत्कटाः। वानरा वानरेन्द्रस्य मन:कान्तं महावनम् ॥ ते
en: They were greatly worked up with anxiety. And beholding that large orchard, those yellowcoloured monkeys were greatly delighted and begged honey of the prince.

sa: तयोरन्योन्यसम्भाषाद् भृशं प्रीतिरजायत। तत्र तौ कीर्तिसम्पन्नौ हरीश्वरनरेश्वरौ॥ परस्परकृताश्वासौ कथया पूर्ववृत्तया।
en: And conversing with each other those two lords of men and monkeys attained great delight. And they consoled each other narrating their respective misfortunes.

sa: भ्रातुरादेशमादाय लक्ष्मणो वा परंतपः। कस्य हेतोर्न मां वीरः परित्राति महाबलः॥
en: And why, taking the permission of his brother, that repressor of foes, the heroic Laks maņa gifted with great strength, dose not deliver me?

sa: दर्शनादेव यः प्राणान्प्राणिनामपि कर्षति। किं पुनः स्पृशमानस्य पात्यमानस्य वा पुनः॥
en: He, who by his very sight draw away the lives of creatures, what should be said of its touching and being hurled at people?

sa: अहं तु राम त्वयि जातकामा चिरं विनाशाय निबद्धभावा। मोघं चरित्वाथ तपो व्रतं च त्यक्ष्यामि धिग्जीवितमल्पभोग्याम्॥
en: (But for me) O Rama, I was for my own destruction, devoted, soul and heart, to you. Oh! fruitless is my asceticism and wifely virtue! Oh fie on me! I shall renounce this my unfortunate life.

sa: ईदृशं किमिदं वाक्यं ममाद्य वदनाच्च्युतम्। अहं व्यामोहितो देवैरिति मन्ये तदागतैः॥
en: What is this speech that has to-day come out from my lips? Meseems I had then been stupefied by the deities that had come.

sa: स वीर्यवान् कथं सीतां हृतां समनुमन्यसे। वसन्ती रक्षसां मध्ये महेन्द्रवरुणोपम॥
en: Why, O you endowed with prowess, resembling Indra the Great or Varuņa, do you disregard the ravished Sītā, sitting in the midst of Raksasa?

sa: स्वप्नेऽपि यद्यहं वीरं राघवं सहलक्ष्मणम्। पश्येयं नावसीदेयं स्वप्नोऽपि मम मत्सरी॥
en: I do not sink even if I can behold in dream the heroic Raghava. along with Laksmana-but dream even is Jealous of my well-being.

sa: अत्राहं वानरेन्द्रेण सुग्रीवेण समागतः॥ समयश्च कृतः सीते वधार्थ वालिनो मया।
en: There I was joined by Sugrīva, the lord of monkeys. And there I entered into an agreement, O Sita, for the destruction of Vali.

sa: कथं च नाम ते राजन्लोकानाक्रम्य तेजसा॥ नारीचौर्यमिदं क्षुद्रं कृतं शौटीर्यमानिना।
en: O king, conquering the worlds with your prowess, how could you, always honoured by the king, cherish the vile desire of stealing away women?

sa: अथाब्रवीत् तदा साध्वी सीता सर्वाङ्गशोभना। रक्षसां कामरूपाणां विज्ञाने का गतिर्मम॥
en: Thereat, the chaste Sītā, having all her parts perfect, answered, “What is my power to read Rākṣasas capable of wearing forms at will? ”

sa: एष पन्थाः सुयोधानां सर्वामरगणेष्वपि।। यः कृते हन्यते भर्तुः स पुमान्स्वर्गमृच्छति॥
en: But this is the way of capable warriors as well as celestials. He that lay down his life for his lord, repair to heaven.

sa: महापार्श्व प्रवदतो रहस्यं किंचिदात्मनः। चिरवृत्तं तदाख्यास्ये यदवाप्तं पुरा मया॥ पितामहस्य भवनं गच्छन्तीं पुञ्जिकस्थलाम्। चञ्चर्यमाणामद्राक्षमाकाशेऽग्निशिखामिव ॥
en: O Mahāparáva, I will relate to you, who have spoken (thus), a secret matter relating to myself, which befell me long since I saw Puñjikasthală, like a flame in the sky, coursing to the Greatfather's mansion.

sa: जानकीरक्षणार्थं वा श्रमाद् वा नोपलक्ष्यते। अथवा कः श्रमस्तस्य सैव तेनाभिरक्षिता॥
en: Whether for preserving Jānakī, or from fatigue—it dose not appear. But what is his fatigue? She it is that has been preserved by him.

sa: प्रीतियुक्तस्य विहितां ससैन्यः ससुहृद्गणः। सत्क्रियां राम मे तावद्गृहाण त्वं मयोद्यताम्॥
en: O Rāma, I shall worship you with great delight and do your, O Rama, with your friends and army, accept that adoration. did you

sa: राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा प्रत्युवाच विभीषणः॥ एष सेनापतिस्तस्य प्रहस्तो नाम राक्षसः। लङ्कायां राक्षसेन्द्रस्य त्रिभागबलसंवृतः।। वीर्यवानस्त्रविच्छूरः सुप्रख्यातपराक्रमः॥
en: Hearing Raghava's words, Vibhîşana answered, In Laňkā this is the general of the lord of Rākşasas-the Rākşasa named Prahasta, surrounded by a third of the forces. He is possessed of prowess and is of distinguished gallantry.

sa: अथ जीवति नः शत्रुर्वयं च कृतसंयुगाः। ततः समभिपत्स्यामो मनसा यत्समीक्षितम्॥
en: But if our foe live after fight and we also having faught the fight, then shall we do what I conceive in my mind.

sa: आश्चर्यमिति रामश्च लक्ष्मणश्चाब्रवीत्तदा॥ अगस्त्यवचनं श्रुत्वा वानरा राक्षसास्तदा। बिभीषणस्तु रामस्य पार्श्वस्थो वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥ आश्चर्यं स्मारितोऽस्म्यद्य यत्तदृष्टं पुरातनम्।
en: Hearing the words of Agastya, Rāma, Lakşmaņa, Vānaras and Rākşasas all said wonderful it is; and Vibhīşaņa, who was by the side of Rama, said:-After a long time, the old recollections have come to my mind.

sa: पावितस्तेन यज्ञेन यास्यसे त्रिदिवं ततः। पुत्रश्च तव देवेन्द्र न विनष्टो महारणे॥ नीतः संनिहितश्चैव आर्यकेण महोदधौ।
en: You shall be purified by that sacrifice and go to heaven; and your son, O lord of celestials, has not been destroyed in the conflict. He has been taken into the ocean by his grand father.

sa: विख्यातं त्रिषु लोकेषु मरुकान्तारमेव च। शोषयित्वा तु तं कुक्षिं रामो दशरथात्मजः।। वरं तस्मै ददौ विद्वान्मरवेऽमरविक्रमः॥
en: Having dried up Marukāntāra famous throughout the three regions, as well as the reservoirs of water Rāma the son of Dasaratha, learned and of god-like prowess, conferred a boon on the desert, saying. *i.e. the sound.

sa: हरादवाप्य ते मन्त्र कामारिमभिवाद्य च। नारायणालयं प्राप्य तस्मै सर्वं न्यवेदयन्॥
en: Having received this counsel of Hara, they, rendering reverence to that enemy of Kāma, came the abode of Nārāyana and communicated everything to him.

sa: अत्र मां कैकयीपुत्रः प्रसादयितुमागतः। एषा सा यमुना रम्या दृश्यते चित्रकानना॥
en: There come in view, O you having a beautiful person, the king of mountains, Citrakūta, where to propitiate me, came the son of Kaikey.

sa: सा तस्य रौद्रा समुपेत्य देहं रौद्रस्य देवाध्वरविप्रशत्रोः। बिभेद वक्षः क्षतजं च भूरि सुस्राव धात्वम्भ इवाद्रिराजः॥
en: And descending on the body of that dreadful one-the enemy of deities, sacrifices and Vipras-that terrific mace rived his breast; and the began to bleed profusely, even as the lord of mountains discharges minerals and water.

sa: न तस्य मध्ये भवनस्य संस्थितो लतागृहांश्चित्रगृहान् निशागृहान्। जगाम सीतां प्रतिदर्शनोत्सुको न चैव तां पश्यति चारुदर्शनाम्॥
en: Remaining in that mansion, (Hanuman) desirous of getting a sight of Sītā graced with a fair presence, went into bowers, and picture galleries, and night-houses;* but her he did not find. *Intended for stay at night.

sa: स निकामं विमानेषु विजरन् कामरूपधृक् । विचचार कपिर्लङ्कां लाघवेन समन्वितः॥
en: Wending about at will on the roofs of sevenstoried edifices, that monkey capable of assuming any form that he chose, began Lankā with speed.

sa: ताम्राः पीताः सिताः श्वेताः पतिताः सूर्यरश्मयः। दृष्यन्ते रावणस्याग्रे पर्वतस्येव धातवः॥
en: The copper coloured, the yellow, the red, and the white rays of the sun falling before Rāvaņa appeared like melted metals of a mountain.

sa: कदा नु खलु सुश्रोणीं शतपत्रायतेक्षणाम्। विजित्य शत्रून्द्रक्ष्यामि सीतां स्फीतामिव श्रियम्॥
en: When shall I, discomfiting my enemies, behold Sītā, having a beautiful waist and eyes resembling lotus-petals, as a victorious hero behold the royal Grace.

sa: ततस्तांस्त्रीन् हतान्ज्ञात्वा वानरेण तरस्विना। अभिगम्य महावेगः प्रहस्य प्रघसो बली॥ भासकर्णश्च संक्रुद्धः शूलमादाय वीर्यवान्। एकतः कपिशार्दूलं यशस्विनमवस्थितौ ॥ पट्टिशेन शिताग्रेण प्रघसः प्रत्यपोथयत्। भासकर्णश्च शूलेन राक्षसः कपिकुञ्चरम्॥
en: Learning that those three had been slain by the monkey gifted with speed, the mighty and onrushing Praghasa laughing in scorn advanced (in the encounter). And the energetic Bhāsakarņa also came forward in rage, taking a dart. And (they) meeting together, Praghasa assailed the famous, tiger-like monkey with a sharp-edged axe, and Bhāsakarņa (attacked) the elephantine monkey with a javelin.

sa: प्रत्यूचुस्तं च राजानो हर्षेण महता वृताः॥ दिष्ट्या त्वं विजयी राम राज्यं चापि प्रतिष्ठितम्। दिष्ट्या प्रत्याहृता सीता दिष्ट्या शत्रुः पराजितः।।२७ एष नः परमः काम एषा नः प्रीतिरुत्तमा। यत्त्वां विजयिनं राम पश्यामो हतशात्रवम्॥ एतत्त्वय्युपपन्नं च यदस्मांस्त्वं प्रशंससे। प्रशंसाह न जानीमः प्रशंसां वक्तुमीदृशीम्॥
en: Whereto the kings, greatly delighted, replied: "O Rāma, it is by your good fortune that you have come off victorious and been installed on the throne; it is by your good luck that you have got back Sītā and the enemy Daśānana has been vanquished. That we behold you, O Rama, victorious and freed from all enemies, is our great benefit and delight. The encomiums, you have showered upon us, are natural with you. You are Rama, who always pleases people. You are worthy of being praised but we do not know how to praise you.

sa: श्रुत्वा च विस्मयं जग्मुरयोध्यापुरवासिनः। वानराणां च तत्कर्म राक्षसानां च तद्बलम्॥
en: Hearing of the amazing works of the monkeys and the prowess of the Rākşasas, the inhabitants of the city of Ayodhyā attained to astonishment.

sa: सखे राघव धर्मज्ञ रिपूणामपि वत्सल। अभ्युनुज्ञातुमिच्छामि गमिष्यामि यथासुखम् ॥ न च कौतूहलं कार्य सखित्वं प्रति कांक्षिणाः। कृतकारणे वीर सखित्वं प्रतिवेत्स्यसि॥
en: My friend Raghava, O you who even cherish affection for your foes, permit me, I shall go at pleasure. And O Raghva, entertain no curiosity as to our friendship. when, O hero, you shall have achieved success in battle, you shall know all about this friendship of ours.

sa: स्वसैन्यमुत्सृज्य समेत्य तूर्णं महाहवे वानरवाहिनीषु। अदृश्यमानः शरजालमुग्रं ववर्ष नीलाम्बुधरो यथाम्बु।५१॥
en: Then in that encounter, leaving his army, Indrajit became suddenly invisible to the monkey-hosts—and began to shower fierce arrows, like dark clouds pouring rain.

sa: ततः स रक्षोधिपतिर्महात्मा सर्वा दिशो बाणगतैः शिताग्रैः। विदारयामास च वानरेन्द्रान्॥
en: Then the high-souled lord of Rākṣasa covered all sides with sharp-pointed shafts resembling the rays of the sun; and he rived the foremost monkeys.

sa: एतच्च पुष्पकं नाम विमानं सूर्यसंनिभम्। प्रतिगृह्णीष्व यानार्थं त्रिदशैः समतां व्रज॥
en: Do you take for your vehicle this car, named Puşpaka, resembling the Sun himself, and thus raise yourself to an equality with the celestials.

sa: ततोऽब्रवीद्धरिवरः सीतामप्रतिजल्पतीम्। किं त्वं चिन्तयसे देवि किं च मां नाभिभाषसे॥
en: Beholding Sītā incapable of replying the foremost of monkeys said, “What are you thinking of O worshipful dame? Why are you not welcoming me?"

sa: भ्रातृपुत्रेण चैतेन दुष्पुत्रेण दुरात्मना । राक्षस्या जिह्मया बुद्ध्या वञ्चितावृजुविक्रमौ ॥
en: And with his guileful mind, that brother's son of mine, wicked-souled and an evil son (to me), has deceived these ones of straight prowess.

sa: अदितिश्च दितिश्चैव भगिन्यौ सहिते हि ते॥ भार्ये परमरूपिण्यौ कश्यपस्य प्रजापतेः।
en: There two sisters-Aditi and Diti, mutually attached to each other, those (damsels) endowed with surpassing beauty, became the wives of that lord of creatures-Kaśyapa.

sa: अहं वै लोकपालानां चतुर्थं स्रष्टुमुद्यतः। यमेन्द्रवरुणानां च पदं यत्तव चेप्सितम्॥
en: I am about to create the fourth of the Protectors of the creatures-Yama, Indra and Varuna, the position which is sought for by you.

sa: भ्रातरं निहतं दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणं रणपांसुषु॥ विजयोऽपि हि मे शूर न प्रियायोपकल्पते। अचक्षुर्विषयश्चन्द्रः कां प्रीतिं जनयिष्यति॥
en: Seeing my brother, Laksmana, wounded, and laying over the dust of the field, even victory, O hero, does not seem to me sweet. If the Moon is hid from the sight, whom does he then delight?

sa: इयं ममात्मजा राजन्हेमयाप्सरसा धृता ॥ कन्या मन्दोदरी नाम पल्यर्थं प्रतिगृह्यताम्।
en: This daughter of mine, O king, O king, borne by the Apsarā, Hemā, this my daughter named Mandodari do you accept as my wife.

sa: उत्क्षिप्तमात्रे दिव्ये च पपात भुवि राक्षसः। छिन्नमूलो यथा शालो रुधिरौघपरिप्लुतः॥
en: As soon as it was uplifted the Rākşasa dropped down on ground, bathed in a pool of blood, like to an uprooted Sāla tree.

sa: सुग्रीवेणैवमुक्तस्तु जाम्बवानृक्षपार्थिवः। वानरान्सान्त्वयामास संनिवर्त्य प्रधावतः॥
en: Thus directed, Jõmbavān-king of bearsrestraining those that were flying, composed the monkeys.

sa: बलेन महता युक्तो राक्षसैर्भीमविक्रमः। त्वं वधायाशु निर्याहि रामस्य सह वानरैः॥
en: O you of dreadful prowess, surrounded by a mighty force, do you march forth to compass the destruction of Rāma along with the monkeys.

sa: तद्भवानद्य काशेय पुरों वाराणसी व्रज। रमणीयां त्वया गुप्तां सुप्राकारां सुतोरणाम्॥
en: O king, do you now leave for your city Varanasi, highly picturesque, well-guarded, girt by strong walls on all sides and having welldecorated gateways.

sa: सर्वथा सुकृतं तावत्सीतायाः परिमार्गणम्। सागरं तु समासाद्य पुनर्नष्टं मनो मम॥
en: Complete success has been attained anent the search of Sītā. But when I think of the ocean, my mind is again sunk in dejection.

sa: प्रत्याख्यानं न जानाति नात्मानं नात्मनः कुलम्। यो नृशंसस्वभावेन मां प्रार्थयितुमिच्छति॥
en: That (demon) who is courting me in this terrible way, does not know himself, his own race and that I loathe him so much.

sa: यथाहं तस्य वीरस्य वनादुपधिना हृता। रक्षसा तद्भयादेव तथा नार्हति राघवः॥
en: It dose not behove the heroic Rāghava, to take me away by steal, like to Rāvaņa capturing me from the forest under a disguise.

sa: एवं बहुविधं वाच्यो रामो दाशरथिस्त्वया। यथा मां प्राप्नुयाच्छीघ्रं हत्वा रावणमाहवे॥
en: Do you thus speak every thing to Rāma, the son of Daśaratha, so that he might soon take me hence, slaying Ravana in battle.

sa: सुखी भव महाबाहो प्रीतास्मि तव वानर। ततोऽहं साधुसाध्वीति सर्वभूतैः प्रशंसितः॥
en: Be you blessed, O mighty-armed one. I am well pleased with you, O monkey.' Then I was praised by all beings, with, 'Excellent!' 'Excellent!'

sa: स तु शोकेन चाविष्टः कोपेन महता कपिः। हनूमानरावणिरथे महतीं पातयच्छिलाम्॥
en: Being overwhelmed with grief and wrought up with ire, that monkey Hanumān, threw a huge crag on the car of that son of Rāvana.

sa: यस्यैषोऽनन्तरः शूरः श्यामः पद्मनिभेक्षणः। इक्ष्वाकूणामतिरथो लोके विश्रुतपौरुषः॥ यस्मिन्न चलते धर्मो यो धर्म नातिवर्तते। यो ब्राह्ममस्त्रं वेदांश्च वेद वेदविदां वरः॥ यो भिन्द्याद्गगनं बाणैर्मेदिनीं वापि दारयेत्। यस्य मृत्योरिव क्रोधः शक्रस्येव पराक्रमः॥ यस्य भार्या जनस्थानात्सीता चापि हृता त्वया। स एष रामस्त्वां राजन्योद्धं समभिवर्तते॥
en: And next to him is the hero of dark-blue hue, having eyes like lotuses, the Atiratha among the Ikswakus-of prowess celebrated in the world-in whom virtue never waver and who never swerve from righteousness; who know the Brāhma Mantra and the Vedas, the best of those versed in them—who pierce the sky with his shaft and cleave the Earth, whose ire is like death, and whose prowess is like that of Sakra, whose wife, Sītā, has been carried away by you from Janasthāna. And this is Rāma, who, O king, advance to encounter you in conflict.

sa: हन्यामहं त्विमौ पापौ शत्रुपक्षप्रशंसिनौ। यदि पूर्वोपकारैर्मे क्रोधो न मृदुतां व्रजेत्॥
en: I shall slay these wicked wights, who praise the side of the enemy, if my anger be not moderated, remembering their former good offices.

sa: ततः स सचिवैः सार्धं षड्भिर्नीत्यबलोद्धतः। महोदरप्रहस्ताभ्यां मारीचशुकसारणैः॥ धूम्राक्षेण च वीरेण नित्यं समरगर्धिना। वृतः संप्रययौ श्रीमान्क्रोधाल्लोकान्दहन्निव॥
en: Accompanied by his six counsellor Mohodara and Prahasta, Marica, Suka and Sarana, and the heroic Dhümrākṣa eager for encounter the graceful Rāvana, elated with his strength sallied out, as if consuming all creatures with his wrath.

sa: अथवा न्यस्तशस्त्रौ तौ वने मूलफलाशनौ। भ्रातरौ हि नरश्रेष्ठौ चरन्तौ वनगोचरौ॥
en: Or those two brothers, the foremost of men, laying aside their weapons, and living on fruits and roots, have been wandering in the forest.

sa: हृतेति मां योऽधिगत्य राघवाय निवेदयेत्। गृध्रराजोऽपि स रणे रावणेन निपातितः॥
en: That lord of vultures, who could have informed Rāghava, of my being born away by the Rākṣasa, was killed by Rāvana in the battle.

sa: सा तु वेदश्रुतिं दृष्ट्वा वै तपसो निधिम्। अभवत्पाण्डुदेहा सा सुव्यञ्जितशरीरजा॥
en: Hearing the sounds of Vedic recitation, and seeing that storehouse of asceticism, she had her body turned pale, and signs of pregnancy displayed themselves.

sa: ऋद्धिंरूपं बलं पुत्रान्वित्तं शूरत्वमेव च। प्राप्नुवन्ति नरा लोके निर्जितं पुण्यकर्मभिः॥
en: In this world people, making their own good fortune and beauty, strength, sons, wealth and valour, gain these by virtue of their pious acts.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा त्वरितं यान्तं नीलाञ्जनचयोपमम्। वानरा दुद्रुवुः सर्वे मन्यमानास्तु रावणिम्॥
en: Seeing him fast making his way, resembling a mass of dark collyrium, the monkeys taking him to be Ravana's son, began to run away.

sa: अत्राहं वानरेन्द्रेण सुग्रीवेण समागतः॥ समयश्च कृतः सीते वधार्थ वालिनो मया।
en: There I was joined by Sugrīva, the lord of monkeys. And there I entered into an agreement, O Sita, for the destruction of Vali.

sa: दशर्वषसहस्रं तु निराहारो दशाननः। पूर्णे वर्षसहस्रे तु शिरश्चाग्नौ जुहाव सः॥
en: The ten-necked passed ten thousand years without fare. On a thousand years being complete, he offered his own head as a sacrifice to Fire.

sa: तत्कर्म वालिपुत्रस्य सर्वे देवाः सहर्षिभिः। तुष्टवुः पूजनार्हस्य तौ चोभौ रामलक्ष्मणौ॥
en: That feat of Väli's son, worthy of being honoured, all the celestials with the saints and both Rāma and Lakşmaņa lauded to the height.

sa: स तु तेन प्रहारेण मैन्दो वानरयूथपः। मर्मण्यभिहतस्तेन पपात भुवि मुर्छितः॥
en: And struck (with those arrows), that leader of monkey-bands, Mainda, with his marrow pierced therewith, fell down to the earth, deprived of his senses.

sa: रावणिस्तु दिशः सर्वा रथेनातिरथोऽपतत्। विव्याध तौ दाशरथी लघ्वस्त्रौ निशितैः शरैः॥
en: And stationed in his chariot that mighty carwarrior disturbed all quarters with his arrows and pierced Dasaratha's sons with sharp shafts won by him.

sa: रावणो नाम दुर्वृत्तो राक्षसो राक्षसेश्वरः। तस्याहमनुजो भ्राता विभीषण इति श्रुतः॥
en: There lives a Raksasa, named Ravana, the lord of demons, and perpetrator of many iniquitous deeds. I am his younger brother known as Vibhişaņa.

sa: ततः शूर्पणखा नाम संजज्ञे विकृतानना। विभीषणश्च धर्मात्मा कैकस्याः पश्चिमः सुतः॥
en: Then was born she that, having a frightful visage, goes under the name of Surpanakha; the righteous Vibhīşaņa is the youngest son of Kaikasi.

sa: एतां कथां महाबाहो नारदः सुमहायशाः। कथयामास दुर्धर्ष मेरौ गिरिवरोत्तमे॥ देवगन्धर्वसिद्धानामृषीणां च महात्मनाम्। कथाशेषं पुनः सोऽथ कथयामास राघव॥ नारदः सुमहातेजाः प्रहसन्निव मानद। तां कथां शृणु राजेन्द्र महापापप्रणाशनीम्॥ यां तु श्रुत्वा महाबाहो ऋषयो दैवतैः सह। ऊचुस्तं नारदं सर्वे हर्षपर्याकुलेक्षणम्॥ यश्चमां श्रावयेन्नित्यं शृणुयाद्वापि भक्तितः। स पुत्रपौत्रवानराम स्वर्गलोके महीयते॥
en: O you having long arms! O you of many glories! O you invincible! Närada recounted this story to me on the summit of mountain-chief Meru. O Rāghava, the highly effulgent one narrated to me the last portion of this story in the presence of the celestials, Gandharvas, Siddhas, ascetics and other great men. O lord of kings, O conferror of honours, do you listen to that story which remove monstrous iniquity. Hearing this you having long arms, said to the ascetic Nārada “He who shall reverentially listen to this story every day, shall be bless with sons and grandsons and be honoured in the region of the celestials.

sa: तमहं गीीरिष्टाभि पुनः पुनररिंदम। अयाचं भृगुशार्दूलं न चैव प्रशशाम सः॥
en: I again and again entreated that best among the Bhrigu race with sweet words, O chastiser among foes, but could not calm him down.

sa: कौशिक्याः संगमे यस्तु दृषद्वत्याश्च भारत॥ स्नाति वै नियताहारः सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते।
en: O descendant of Bharata, he who at the confluence of the Kaushiki and the Drishadvati bathes with regulated diet is freed from all sins.

sa: मम रामस्य लोकस्य गुरुणां भरतस्य च। प्रियमेतद् गुरुश्रोणि कुरु चारुमुखेक्षणे॥
en: O you of well-developed hips, do you do this act of benefit to me and Ráma and the people and the superiors, and Bharata.

sa: कुलात् तु तव धर्मात्मन् कन्यां सोऽधिगमिष्यति। उद्भावनार्थं भवतो वंशस्य नृपसत्तम॥
en: O you of righteous soul, Jamadagni will marry a girl, taking her from your race, for spreading its glory, O chief of the Bharatas.

sa: द्रोणस्तु रथिनः श्रेष्ठान् सोमकान् संजयैः सह। अभ्यधावत संक्रुद्धः प्रेषयिष्यन् यमक्षयम्॥
en: Then that foremost of car-warriors namely Drona, excited with rage, rushed against the 'Somakas and the Srinjayas, dispatching them to the mansion of death.

sa: नैष धर्मः सतां देवा यत्र वध्येत वै पशुः। इदं कृतयुगं श्रेष्ठं कथं वध्येत वै पशुः॥
en: O gods, that cannot be the religion of good and pious people in which the destruction of animals is sanctioned. This, again, is the golden age. How can animals be killed in this epoch of righteousness?

sa: यत्कृते पृथिवी सर्वा सुहृदो बान्धवास्तथा। हतास्माभिः प्रसह्याजौ क्लिष्टैः पूर्वं महावने॥
en: It was for him that friends, kinsmen, over the whole Earth destroyed by is were whom he had greatly afflicted in the deep forest.

sa: इतः कृतयुगेऽतीते विपर्यासं गतेऽपि च। वैवस्वतेऽन्तरे विप्राः प्राप्ते त्रेतायुगे पुनः॥ सुराणां कार्यसिद्ध्यर्थं सहाया वै भविष्यथा
en: After the expiration of this the golden age, when the Treta age comes in course of the Vivasvat cycle, a great calamity will befall the world. You Munis, you shall then have to help the gods.

sa: द्वीपेषु तेषु सर्वेषु प्रजानां कुरुसत्तम। ब्रह्मचर्येण सत्येन प्रजानां हि दमेन च॥ आरोग्यायुःप्रमाणाभ्यां द्विगुणं द्विगुणं ततः। एको जनपदो राजन् द्वीपेष्वेतेषु भारत।
en: O king, in all these islands Brahmacharya, truth, self-control, also health and length of life are in the ratio of one to two as the island are more and more remote northwards. O king, O descendant of Bharata, the land in all these islands is but one country.

sa: आसाद्य माममोधेषु गमिष्यन्ति दिशो दश। पाण्डवाः सहपञ्चालाः शार्दूलं वृषभा इव॥
en: Standing against me who are infallible they will be routed in ten directions, the Pandavas with the Panchalas, like bulls meeting with a tiger.

sa: त्वया व्याप्तानि सर्वाणि भूतानि भुवनेश्वर। योगिनः सुमहावीर्याः स्तुवन्ति त्वां महर्षयः॥
en: O lord of earth all created things are pervaded by you. The great Rishis and the greatly effulgent Yogis all adore you with hymns.

sa: तथैव कौरवेयाणां भीमसेनो महाबलः। चकार कदनं घोरं क्रुद्धः काल इवापरः॥
en: On the other hand, the highly puissant Bhimasena, waxing worth, caused a dreadful carnage among the Kaurava ranks like another god of Death himself.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच आसां प्रजानां परिपालनेन स्वं क्षत्रधर्मं परिपालयामि। प्रब्रूहि मे किं करणीयमद्य येनासि कार्येण समागतस्त्वम्॥
en: Janamejaya said : I perform the duties of my Kshatriya race, by looking after my these subjects. Tell me what is the business that I am to perform by which you are led to come here.

sa: त्वां प्राप्य वैरपुरुषं कुरूणामनयो महान्। उपस्थितो विनाशाय यतस्व पुरुषो भव॥
en: Having come across yourself, an illustrated man, the Kurus have come upon a great disaster; try to mete out destruction and be a man.

sa: ते गजा घनसंकाशा: पेतुरुा समन्ततः। वज्रनुन्ना इव बभुः पर्वता युगसंक्षये॥
en: Those elephants, resembling clouds dropped on the earth like mountai is clapped by a thunder, O lord, at the time of the universal dissolution.

sa: नातिभारोऽस्ति दैवस्य ध्रुवं माधव कश्चन। यदिमे निहताः शूराः क्षत्रियैः क्षत्रियर्षभाः॥
en: forsooth, O Madhava, there is nothing difficult for destiny to bring about, since these leading men, these heroes, have been killed by Kshatriya warriors!

sa: ननु पर्याप्तमेवं ते पापे रामविवासनम्। किमेभिः कृपणैर्भूयः पातकैरपि ते कृतैः॥
en: Surely, O nefarious one, the banishment of Ráma is enough for you. Why then do you bend your mind to perpetrate these atrocious sins?

sa: सा मुहूर्ते च राजेन्द्र पुत्रशोकाभिपीडिता। कश्मलाभिहता वीर वैराटी त्वभवत् तदा॥
en: Greatly stricken with grief on account of her son, Virata's daughter, O king, seemed to be struck down for sometime by sorrow and cheerlessness.

sa: यदा ह्यासीदत: पापान् दहत्युग्रेण तेजसा। मिथ्योपचरितो राजा तदा भवति पावकः॥
en: When the king, imposed on by falsehood, consumes with his dreadful offenders before him, he is said to put on the form of Agni.

sa: यदा गन्धर्वयोनौ वा वर्तामि भृगुनन्दना तदा गन्धर्ववत् सर्वमाचरामि न संशयः॥
en: When I live in the order of the Gandharvas, I then, O son of Bhrigu's race, act in every . respect as a Gandharva.

sa: गन्धर्वाश्च महात्मानः सङ्घशश्चाप्सरोगणाः। वादित्रं नृत्यगीतं य हास्यं लास्यं च सर्वशः॥
en: Many illustrious Gandharvas and many Apsaras fill all parts of it with both instrumental and vocal music, and with sounds of dances and laughter.

sa: ईदृशी सा सभा राजन् पितृराज्ञो महात्मनः। वरुणस्यापि वक्ष्यामि सभां पुष्करमालिनीम्॥
en: O king, such is the assembly-hall of the illustrious king of the Pitris (Yama). I shall now describe the Sabha of Varuna, named Pushkaramalini

sa: स कदाचिनृपश्रेष्ठो ययातिः शक्रमागमत्। कथान्ते तत्र शक्रेण स पृष्टः पृथिवीपतिः।३॥
en: One day the best of kings, Yayati, went to Indra and in the course of conversation the lord of earth was asked by Indra.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच स्वर्गतः स तु राजेन्द्रो निवसन् देववेश्मनि। पूजितस्त्रिदशैः साध्यैर्मरुद्भिर्वसुभिस्तथा॥
en: Vaishampayana said : When that great king was living in heaven, he was adored by the celestials, the Sadhyas, the Marutas and the Vasus.

sa: सुकुमारौ कथं पादौ मुखं च कमलप्रभम्। मत्कृतेऽद्य वरार्हायाः श्यामतां समुपागतम्॥
en: The delicate hands and the lotus-like feet of this lady who deserve all excellent things have become dark blue in colour on my account.

sa: स एवमुक्त्वा नृपतिः पुत्रो दुर्योधनस्तव। नोवाच वचनं किञ्चिद् भीष्मं सत्यपराक्रमम्॥
en: He will conquer the sons of Pritha together with all their friends, allies and kinsmen." Having thus spoken, your royal son dreadful prowess. airunn

sa: गच्छ केशिनि भूयस्त्वं परीक्षां कुरु बाहुके। अब्रुवाणा समीपस्था चरितान्यस्य लक्षय॥
en: "O Keshini, do you go again and scrutinize the conduct of Bahuka; and keeping yourself in silence at his side, behold all his bevaviours.

sa: अनन्तरत्नान्यादाय स जहार महाक्रतून्। सुषाव च बहून् सोमान् सोमसंस्थास्ततान च॥
en: Collecting jewels and precious stones, he performed afterwards great sacrifices. Extracting a large quantity of Soma juice, he performed (the great sacrifice) Soma Sanstha.

sa: नाद्य शक्या मया हन्तुं पाण्डवा जितकाशिनः॥ बलवन्तः कृतोत्साहाः प्राप्तलक्ष्याः प्रहारिणः।
en: The victorious Pandavas are incapable of being killed by me! They are possessed of power and perseverance, sure of aim, and skilled in smiting.

sa: राज्यं हि सुमहत् तन्त्रं धार्यते नाकृतात्मभिः। न शक्यं मृदुना वोढुमायासस्थानमुत्तमम्॥
en: Wily persons can not govern an extensive empire, A king who is mild cannot acquire superior rank the acquisition of which depends upon exertion.

sa: बृहस्पतेरुशनसो नोपदेशः श्रुतस्त्वया॥ वृद्धा नोपासिताश्चैव हितं वाक्यं न ते श्रुतम्।
en: You had never listened to the advice of Brihaspati and Ushanas! You had never respected the old! You had never heard the beneficial words!

sa: यस्तु निःश्रेयसं श्रुत्वा प्राक् तदेवाभिपद्यते। आत्मनो मतमुत्सृज्य स लोके सुखमेधते॥
en: He, who having heard that, than which nothing is more beneficial, acts up to it abandoning his own opinions, gets happiness in this world.

sa: संजय उवाच ततः स सात्यकिर्थीमान् महात्मावृष्णिपुङ्गवः। सुदर्शनं निहत्याजौ यन्तारं पुनरब्रवीत्॥
en: Sanjaya said Thereafter that illustrious scion of the Vrishni race, the high-souled and intelligent Satyaki, having slain Sudarsana in battle, addressing charioteer thus spoke.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच पूर्वं कृतयुगे राजन् नैमिषेयास्तपस्विनः। वर्तमाने सुविपुले सत्रे द्वादशवार्षिके॥
en: Vaishampayana said "Formerly, in the Satya Yuga, O king, the ascetics living in Naimisha were engaged in a great sacrifice extending for twelve years.

sa: पूर्वाह्ने तु महाराज प्रावर्तत जनक्षयः। तं त्वमेकमना भूत्वा शृणु देवासुरोपमम्॥
en: That afternoon, O mighty monarch a great destruction of creatures took place. Hear of me, with singleness of attention of that battle that ras.

sa: अनुजग्मुश्च तं वीरं देव्यस्ता वै स्वलंकृताः। स्त्रीसहस्रः परिवृता वधूभिश्च सहस्रशः॥
en: The body of the hero was followed by his wives decked in ornaments and surrounded by thousands of women and thousands of their daughter-in-law.

sa: सम्भूताः सर्वसम्भारास्तस्मिन् राजन् महाक्रतौ। न तत्र पशुघातोऽभूत् स राजैवं स्थितोऽभवत्॥
en: In that great sacrifice, O king, all the necessary articles were collected. No animals were killed in it. The king had ordained it so.

sa: सर्वातिथ्यं त्रिवर्गस्य कुर्वाण: सुमनाः सदा। शूद्राणां चान्नकामानां नित्यं सिद्धमिति ब्रुवन्॥
en: He should pursue the three-fold objects of life, and be always cheerful. He should always say "it is ready” to Shudras desirous of food.

sa: तमिन्द्रो ब्राह्मणो भूत्वा भिक्षार्थी समुपागमत्। कुण्डले प्रार्थयामास कवचं च महाद्युतिः॥
en: Indra, assuming the form of a Brahmana, came to him for alms. Ever engaged to do good to Arjuna, he asked for the armour.

sa: इच्छया ते प्रवल्गन्ति ये सत्त्वा रात्रिचारिणः दिवाचराश्च ये सत्त्वास्ते निद्रावशमागताः॥
en: Creators, ranging in the night, began to howl and utter their cries at will, while they that range in the day began to sleep.

sa: जीवन्ती मां यथा रामः सम्भावयति कीर्तिमान्। तत्त्वया हनुमन्वाच्यं वाचा धर्ममवाप्नुहि॥
en: O Hanumān, do you speak so that the illustrious Rāma may deliver me while I am still alive; and thereby do you reap righteousness.

sa: सा वध्यमाना समरे धार्तराष्ट्री महाचमूः। वेगान् बहुविधांश्चक्रे विषं पीत्वेव मानवः॥
en: This slaughtered in battle, the mighty army of the sons of Dhritarashtra performed various movements like a man reeling through the effects of poisoning.

sa: संनिदेशे पितुस्तिष्ठ यथानेन प्रतिश्रुतम्। त्वयारण्यं प्रवेष्टव्यं नव वर्षाणि पञ्च च॥
en: Your father is bound to me by promise, obeying therefore your father's mandate, do you repair to the forest for nine years and five.

sa: एवं भवतु भद्रं वः कुशध्वजसुते इमे। पत्न्यौ भजेतां सहितौ शत्रुघ्नभरताबुभौ॥
en: Whatever you wish, even that shall be done, good betide you. Let these daughters of Kusadhvaja together become the wives of Śatrughna and Bharata.

sa: गौतमस्तु ततः क्रुद्धो धनुर्गृह्य नवं दृढम्। सुकेतुं त्रिंशता बाणैः सर्वमर्मस्वताडयत्॥
en: Thereupon worked up with anger Gautama took up a fresh and strong bow and cut-off Suketu to the very vital part with thirty arrows.

sa: वाहनानि च देयानि हया मत्ताश्च वारणाः। शयनं शिबिकाश्चैव स्यन्दनाश्च स्वलंकृताः॥
en: Animals also should be given, such as horses and elephants, and beds, and covered conveyances borne on the shoulders of men, and well-decked cars.

sa: दत्त्वोवाच ततः शंभु वज्ञेयमिदं त्वया। अवज्ञातं यदि हि ते मामेवैष्यत्यसंशयः॥
en: And making (the sword) over to him, Sambhu said, “You must not disregard this. If disregarded, it will for certain come (back) to me?'

sa: स ताड्यमानो बहुभिः शरैः संनतपर्वभिः। न विव्यथे राक्षसेन्द्रो भिद्यमान इवाचलः॥
en: Wounded with innumerable this straight jointed shafts, that foremost of the Rakshusas did not fight, (but stood firm) like a mountain though cleft open.

sa: शुद्धात्मानौ यदि त्वेतौ जानीहि त्वं प्लवङ्गम। व्याभाषितैर्वा रूपैर्वा विज्ञेया दुष्टताऽनयोः॥
en: O monkey, if you determine the fairness and unfairness of their purpose, their wickedness should be discovered by means of their gestures and conversation.

sa: वासुदेवेन तीर्थेन तात गच्छस्व संशमम्। कालप्राप्तमिदं मन्ये मा त्वं दुर्योधनातिगाः॥
en: By the help if Vasudeva, make peace (with the Pandavas); I think the proper time has now arrived; O Dhritarashtra, do not disobey me.

sa: इयं तात सुखा शय्या त्वदर्थमुपकल्पिता। प्रत्याश्वसिहि साध्वस्यां राजपुत्र यथासुखम् ॥
en: This O child, is the easeful bed that has been prepared for you. O prince, do you as you listen, lie down upon it.

sa: स तांश्छित्त्वा महाबाहुस्तोमरान् निशितैः शरैः। भगदत्तं च विव्याध सप्तत्या कङ्कपत्रिभिः॥
en: Then that Rakshasa of mighty arms cutting off those Tomaras, pierced Bhagadatta with seventy shafts of exceeding sharpness, all resembling the thunderbolt of Heaven.

sa: अस्य प्रसादादाशंसे लोकेऽस्मिन् सुमहद् यशः। धर्मावाप्ति च विपुलामर्थकामौ च पुष्कलौ॥
en: Through his grace I hope in this world to attain high fame, and great religious merit as well as completely secure profit and pleasure.

sa: स चिन्तयामास तदा निषधाधिपतिर्बली। अस्ति भक्ष्यो ममाद्यायं वसु चेदं भविष्यति॥
en: Thereupon the powerful ruler of the Nishadhas, thought (within himself)-My food today will consist of these and afterwards their plumage shall be my wealth.

sa: तस्मिन्नतिरथे द्रोणे निहते पार्षतेन वै। कौरवेषु च भग्नेषु कुन्तीपुत्रो धनंजयः॥
en: Sanjaya said When that Atiratha Drona had been slain by the son of Prisata and when the Kaurava ranks broken and routed, Kunti's Dhananjaya.

sa: ततो गच्छेतधर्मज्ञ विष्णो: स्थानमनुत्तमम्। सततं नाम राजेन्द्र यत्र संनिहितो हरिः॥
en: O virtuous man, O king of kings, one should then go to the excellent region of Vishnu, called Satata, where Hari is always present.

sa: अदितेरात्मजा वीरा दितेः पुत्रान् निजघ्निरे। अस्मिन् घोरे महायुद्धे दैतेयादित्ययो शम्॥
en: And in that exceedingly dreadful battle between the sons of Diti and Aditi, those heroic ones viz., Aditi's heroic sons slaughtered those of Diti.

sa: तान् दृष्ट्वा राजशार्दूलो वसिष्ठं पर्यपृच्छत। असौम्याः पक्षिणो घोरा मृगाश्चापि प्रदक्षिणाः॥ किमिदं हृदयोत्कम्पि मनो मम विषीदति।
en: Beholding them, that tiger-like monarch asked Vasistha, saying, Those birds of fierce aspects emit frightful cries and beasts stream in a Southerly direction. What is this? My heart tremble and my mind is not at ease.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच प्रतिश्रुते दासभावे दुहित्रा वृषपर्वणः। देवयानी नृपश्रेष्ठ पितरं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O best of kings, when Sharmishtha thus promised to be the maid-servant of Devayani, she then thus spoke to her father.

sa: शर्मिष्ठोवाच येन केनचिदार्तानां ज्ञातीनां सुखमावहेत्। अतस्त्वामनुयास्यामि यत्र दास्यति ते पिता॥
en: Sharmishtha said : One must try to do good to one's affected relatives. Therefore, I shall follow you where your father will bestow you.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तं शयानं महात्मानं वीरमानकदुन्दुभिम्। पुत्रशोकेन संतप्तं ददर्श कुरुपुङ्गवः॥
en: Vaishampayana said, The Kuru prince saw the heroic and great Anakadundubhi lying on the ground, and burning with grief on account of his sons.

sa: गिरयः पर्वताश्चैव सन्ति तत्र समासतः। नद्यश्च सरितो वारि वहन्त्यो ब्रह्मसम्भवम्॥
en: Hills and mountains also exist there, in a body; and rivers and steams carrying waters in their course, waters that are born of Brahma.

sa: तौ हि वीरौ नरवरौ सहितौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। आगम्य नगरी लङ्कां सायकैर्विधमिष्यतः॥
en: Those heroes and foremost of men, Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa both, coming to the city of Lankā, shall destroy her by means of their shafts.

sa: एवं हि वरदं नाम केशवेति ममार्जुन। देवानामथ सर्वेषामृषीणां च महात्मनाम्॥
en: This name of mine, therefore, O Arjuna, is productive of boons to them who utter it among all the gods and the great Rishis.

sa: एवं देवगणैः सर्वैः सोऽभिषिक्तः स्वलंकृतः। बभौ प्रतीत: सुमनाः परिपूर्णेन्दुमण्डल डलः॥
en: Thus installed by all the celestial, he looked pleased and complacient. Dressed in his best style, he looked as beautiful as the full moon.

sa: कृतापराधस्य हि ते नान्यत् पश्याम्यहं क्षमम्। अन्तरेणाञ्जलिं बद्ध्वा लक्ष्मणस्य प्रसादनात्॥
en: You have acted improperly towards him, and I do not find any thing tending to your welfare but your satisfying Lakşmana with folded hands.

sa: अभिद्रवत गाङ्गेयं सोमकाः सृञ्जयैः सह। सेनापतिवचः श्रुत्वा समोकाः सृञ्जयाश्च ते॥
en: "Rush you, O Somakas, together with the Srinjayas at the son of Ganga.” Hearing those words of their commander-in-chief, the Somakas and the Srinjayas,

sa: गाण्डीवं तु धनुर्दिव्यं न मुमोच धनञ्जयः। रत्नलोभान्महाराज ते चाक्षय्ये महेषुधी॥
en: Dhananjaya had not thrown off is celestial bow Gandiva nor his couple of inexhaustible quivers, actuated, O king by the cupidity for valuable things.

sa: सा सुकेशी सुनासोरू: सुरूपा च यशस्विनी। देवतेव वनस्यास्य राजते श्रीरिवापरा॥
en: And that fair-haired, fair-nosed, and fairthighed illustrious one possessed of beauty, grace the forest like a goddess, as if a goddess of wealth herself.

sa: सर्वथा नैतदाश्चर्ये यत् त्वं हरिगणेश्वर। न विस्मरसि सुस्निग्धमुपकारं कृतं शुभम्॥
en: It is no wonder, O lord of monkeys, that you had not forgot the unexpected benefit, (you hadst received at the hands of Rāma).

sa: एष योगविधिः कृत्स्नो यावदिन्द्रियधारणम्। एतन्मूलं हि तपसः कृत्स्नस्य नरकस्य च।॥
en: This subjugation of the senses is the highest means of attaining spiritual advancement; it is also at the root of all our spiritual degradation.

sa: युधिष्ठिरस्तुधर्मात्मा तद् ब्रह्म मनसा यतः। धारयामास मेधावी काले काले सदाभ्यसन्॥
en: Having received that knowledge, the virtuous-minded and the intelligent Yudhishthira carefully retained it in his memory and always repeated it at the proper times.

sa: अशेत भूमौ सह पाण्डुपुत्रैः पादोपधानीव कृता कुशेषु। न तत्र दुःखं मनसापि तस्या न चावमेने कुरुपुङ्गवांस्तान्॥
en: Through she lay on Kusha grass and in the ground, like the nether pillow of the sons of Pandu, yet she felt no grief in her heart or any disrespect for those best of the Kurus.

sa: सर्वज्ञं त्वां कथं मोह आविशत् स्वर्गवासिनम्। एवमद्भुतकर्माणमिति मे संशयो महान्॥
en: I am at a great loss to understand how you became subject to illusion who performed excellent deeds and obtained an abode in heaven.

sa: तत्र स्नात्वार्चयित्वा च पितॄन् वै दैवतानि च। उषित्वा रजनीमेकामग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत्॥
en: Bathing in it and worshipping the Pitris and the celestials and living there only for a night, one obtains the fruit of Agnishtoma (sacrifice).

sa: शृणुमैथिलि मद्वाक्यं मासान् द्वादश भामिनि ॥ कालेनानेन नाभ्येषि यदि मां चारुहासिनि। ततस्त्वां प्रातराशार्थं सूदाश्छेत्स्यन्ति लेशशः॥
en: Hear, O Maithili, my words. O damsel if, O you of sweet smiles, within this time you do not turn yourself to me, the cooks shall cut you off in pieces to serve my morning mcal.

sa: सरस्वत्या वरे तीर्थे उन्मजशशलक्षणः। पुनर्वर्धिष्यते देवास्तद् वै सत्यं वचो मम॥
en: Having bathed also in that foremost of tirthas on the Sarasvati, the hare-embalmed god shall regain his strength. These words of mine are true.

sa: अग्नौ प्रक्षिप्यतामेष च्छिद्यतां खण्डशोऽपि वा। न ह्ययं बालहा पापश्चिरं जीवितुमर्हति॥
en: Shall I throw it into the fire or shall I cut it into pieces? This infamous killer of a child should not live longer!

sa: तथैव विश्वेदेवेभ्यो बलिमाकाशतो हरेत्। निशाचरेभ्यो भूतेभ्यो बलिं नक्तं तथा हरेत्॥
en: To the Vishvedevas it should be offered in open air, and to the Rakshasas and evil spirits the offerings should be made at night.

sa: प्राणापानावुदानश्च समानो व्यान एव च। पञ्चहोतूंस्तथैतान् वै परं भावं विदुर्बुधाः॥
en: The learned know this to be a great principle that Prana and Apana and Udana and Şamana and Vyana are the five sacrificing priests.

sa: अष्टम्यां पुनरस्माभिरादित्यस्योदयं प्रति। इमा गावो ग्रहीतव्या गते मत्स्ये गवां पदम्॥
en: And at sun-rise of the eighth lunar day we should seize these kine when the king of Matsya's would be pursuing those seized first,

sa: स तं पुरोहितमुपादायोपावृत्तो भ्रातूनुवाच-'मयाऽयं वृत उपाध्याय यदयं ब्रूयात्तत् कार्यमविचारयद्भिर्भवद्भिः' इति। तेनैवमुक्ता भ्रातरस्तस्य तथा चक्रुः स तथा भ्रातृन् संदिश्य तक्षशिलां प्रत्यभिप्रतस्थे तं च देशं वशे स्थापयामास॥
en: He then took him as his priest and returned to his capital. He then addressed his brothers thus, I have chosen this person as my priest. Whatever he will command to do must be obeyed by you without questioning.” The brothers did as they were requested. Giving these instructions to his brothers he marched against Takshashila and conquered that country.

sa: ब्रह्मणा त्वेवमुक्तस्तु रुद्रः क्रोधाग्निमुत्सृजन्। प्रसादयामास ततो देवं नारायणं प्रभुम्। शरणं च जगामाद्यं वरेण्यं वरदं प्रभुम्॥
en: Thus addressed by Brahman, Rudra iminediately renounced the fire of his anger and began to please the illustrious and powerful Narayana. Indeed, he soon placed himself at the disposal of the worshipful, boongiving, and powerful Narayana.

sa: न शुश्रूषसि तद् वाक्यं मर्त्यः पथ्यमिवौषधम्। तदेव त्वामनुप्राप्तं वचनं साधुभाषितम्॥
en: You did not listen to, like one on death-bed neglecting wholesome medicine. It is now that you relies those words spoken by the righteous.

sa: हत्वा चैनं नामृत: स्यादयं मे जीवत्यस्मिन् कोऽत्ययः स्यादयं ते। अस्योत्सर्गे प्राणयुक्तस्य जन्तोर्मृत्योर्लोकं को नु गच्छेदनन्तम्॥
en: By killing this serpent, this my boy will not revive, and by letting it live, no harm will be caused to you. Who would go to the endless regions of Death by killing this living creature?

sa: इहैव हर्षोऽस्तु समागतानां क्षिप्रं कृतास्त्रेणधनंजयेन। इति ब्रुवन्तः परमाशिषस्ते पार्थास्तपोयोगपरा बभूवुः॥
en: Saying "let all those assembled experience joy by meeting speedily here with Arjuna skilled in arms," those highly blessed Parthas became absorbed in Yoga.

sa: समृद्ध्या ह्यस्य लोकस्य लोको युष्माकमध्यति। इमं च लोकं शोचन्तमनुशोचन्ति देवताः॥
en: If prosperity attends the human race, your (Rakshasa) race will also be prosperous. If calamity falls on men, even the celestials thereby suffer grief.

sa: अहं हि द्वारकायाश्च पितुश्च कुरुनन्दन। तेषु रक्षां समाधाय प्रयातः सौभपातने।॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, having reposed on them the duty of protecting Dvarka and my father, I had come to the destruction of Saubha.

sa: त्रयस्त्रिंशद् यथा देवाः सर्वे शक्रपुरोगमाः। सम्पूज्याः सर्वलोकस्य तथा वृद्धाविमौ मम॥
en: Thirty three million gods with Indra at their head, are worshipped by all men, so are these aged parents of mine worshipped by me.

sa: स राजानमुपातिष्ठद् बाहुकोऽहमिति ब्रुवन्। अश्वानां वाहने युक्तः पृथिव्यां नास्ति मत्समः॥
en: He approached the king with these words: “I am Bahuka, skilled in the management of horses. I have not a peer in this earth.

sa: प्रत्यक्षमिह विप्रर्षे देवा दृश्यन्ति सत्तम। सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ वायुः पृथिवी वह्निरेव च॥
en: O Brahmanical sages, O foremost of men, the sun, the moon, the earth and the fire look like the deities in their embodied forms.

sa: स वै सम्भाष्यमाणोऽन्यैः कोपाद् गिरिमुवाच ह। य इह व्याहरेत् कश्चिदुपलानुत्सृजेस्तथा॥
en: He, being addressed by others, spoke thus to the hill in anger, who ever will utter words hero (O hill) throw stones at him."

sa: एते चान्ये च बहवो गणा दिग्भ्यः समागताः। अन्यैश्चोपाहतान्यत्र रत्नानीह महात्मभिः॥
en: These and many other (kings), coming from various regions, and also others who brought a great mass of gems and jewels, all assembled there.

sa: ममैष लक्ष्यभूतो हि मम पूर्वपरिग्रहः। ममैव च प्रहारेण जीविताद् व्यपरोपितः॥
en: He was first aimed by me, he was first claimed by mc and it is from my shot that he has lost his life.

sa: व्याध उवाच श्रुतिप्रमाणो धर्मोऽयमिति वृद्धानुशासनम्। सूक्ष्मा गतिर्हि धर्मस्य बहुशाखा ह्यनन्तिका॥
en: The Fowler said: It is ordained by the old as found in the Shruti that the ways of virtue are subtle, diverse and infinite.

sa: ततो निबध्य तां नावमदूरे काश्यपाश्रमात्। चारयामास पुरुषैर्विहारं तस्य वै मुनेः॥
en: Thereupon she moored that boat near the hermitage of Kashyapa's son and the sent men to survey the place which the Rishi generally frequented.

sa: मरुतां च गणास्तत्र देवयानैरुपागमन्। महेन्द्रानुचरा ये च ये च सद्मनिवासिनः॥
en: And the whole body of the Marutas, the followers of Mahendra and all the inhabitants of the heavenly regions appeared there on celestials cars.

sa: भवता चानुगुप्तोऽसौ चरेत् तीर्थानि सर्वशः। रक्षोभ्यो रक्षितव्यश्च दुर्गेषु विषमेषु च॥
en: (He said), “Let him go to all the Tirthas protected by you. You should protect him from the Rakshasas in inaccessible and rugged places.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्येवंवादिनं वीरं भीममक्लिष्टकारिणम्। भोगेन महता गृह्य समन्तात् पर्यवेष्टयत्॥
en: When the heroic Bhima of great achievements was saying all this, the serpent seized him and coiled him all round with its gigantic body.

sa: मघवानपि देवेशो रथमारुह्य सुप्रभम। उवाच भगवान् स्वर्गं गन्तव्यं फाल्गुन त्वया॥
en: And the lord king of the gods-Maghavana too, having ascended his splendid car, said "O Falguni, you will have to visit the celestials regions.

sa: अस्मानपि महाराज नेतुमर्हसि पाण्डव। अस्माभिर्हि न शक्यानि त्वदृते तानि कौरव॥
en: O great king, O Pandava, O descendant of Kuru, you should take us with you. Without you we shall never able to visit them.

sa: स वाच्यो मम संदेशाद्धर्मात्मा सत्यसंगरः। नोत्कण्ठा फाल्गुने कार्या कृतास्त्रः शीघ्रमेष्यति॥
en: On my behalf tell that invincible and virtuous hero that he should not be anxious for Falguni. He will soon return acquiring all weapons.

sa: श्रीकुण्डं तु समासाद्य त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्। पितामहं नमस्कृत्य गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: Going to Srikunda, celebrated over the three worlds and bowing there to the Grandsire, one obtains the fruit of giving away one thousand kine.

sa: धनुर्चाहश्चार्जुनः सव्यसाची धनुश्च तद् गाण्डिवं भीमवेगम्। अस्त्राणि दिव्यानि च तानि तस्य त्रयस्य तेजः प्रसहेत कोऽत्र॥
en: The wielder of the bow is Arjuna Savyasachi, the bow is the Gandiva of fearful energy, the weapons are also all celestials, who is there who would be able to withstand the (combination of these) three."

sa: क्षमावतामयं लोकः परश्चैव क्षमावताम्। इह सम्मानमृच्छन्ति परत्र च शुभां गतिम्॥
en: This world belongs to the forgiving, the other world also belongs to the forgiving, they obtain honors here and holy blessedness in the next.

sa: द्रौपद्युवाच लोभो धर्मस्य नाशाय भगवन् नाहमुत्सहे। अनर्हा वरमादातुं तृतीयं राजसत्तम॥
en: Draupadi said O illustrious one, covetousness destroys virtue. O foremost of kings, I do not deserve a third boon; I dare not ask any.

sa: ते दुर्गवासं बहुधा निरुष्य व्यतीत्य कैलासमचिन्त्यरूपम्। आसेदुरत्यर्थमनोरमं ते तमाश्रमाचयं वृषपर्वणस्तु॥
en: (Thus) resting in many inaccessible places and crossing the mountain Kailasa of incomprehensible grandeur, they at length reached the exceedingly beautiful hermitage of Vrishaparva.

sa: धर्ममूलं जगद् राजन् नान्यद्धर्माद् विशिष्यते। धर्मश्चार्थेन महता शक्यो राजन् निषेवितुम्॥
en: O king, the universe depends on virtue. There is nothing higher than virtue. O king, virtue is attainable (only) by those who possess wealth.

sa: प्रथमं प्रतिबुध्यामि चरमं संविशामि च। नित्यकालमहं सत्ये एतत् संवननं मम॥
en: I used to rise up from my bed first and to go to my bed last. O Satyabhama, this has ever been my custom.

sa: अधिराजाधिपं चैव दन्तवक्रं महाबलम्। जिगाय करदं चैव कृत्वा राज्ये न्यवेशयत्॥
en: Having vanquished the powerful king of the Adhirajas, Dantavakra, and having made him pay tribute, the hero (Sahadeva) then replaced him on his throne.

sa: समेत्य पार्थेन यथैकरात्र मूषुः समास्तत्र तदा चतस्रः। पूर्वाश्च षट् ता दश पाण्डवानां शिवा बभूवुर्वसतां वनेषु॥
en: In company with Partha they lived there for four years which appeared to them (short) as a single night. The former six years and these four together numbering ten of their forest life glided smoothly away.

sa: पराजितो नकुलो भीमसेनो युधिष्ठिरः सहदेवार्जुनौ च। दासीभूता त्वं हि वै याज्ञसेनि पराजितास्ते पतयो नैव सन्ति।॥
en: O beautiful lady, select now another husband who will not make you a slave by gambling. It is well known that it is not censurable in a slave to proceed with freedom in selecting her husband.

sa: अजेयस्त्वं रणेऽरीणामुमापतिरिव प्रभुः। एतत् ते प्रथमं देव ख्यातं कर्म भविष्यति॥
en: O god, you are as invincible in battle as the husband of Uma (Shiva). This victory will be celebrated as your first great achievement.

sa: रक्मपट्टपिनद्धां तां शत्रूणां भयवर्धिनीम्। प्रगृह्याथ नदन भीमः शैक्यां सर्वायसीं गदाम्॥
en: And then taking up his iron mace termed Shaika, in-laid with plates of gold and increasing the fear of his enemies, Bhiina, uttering yells,

sa: जनमेजय उवाच तस्मिन् कृतास्त्रे रथिनां प्रवीरे प्रत्यागते भवनाद् वृत्रहन्तुः। अतः परं किमकुर्वन्त पार्थाः समेत्य शूरेणधनंजयेन॥
en: Janamejaya said : On the return of that best of the car-warriors from the abode of the slayer of Vitra (Indra) being skilled in arms, what did the Parthas do in company with the heroic Dhananjaya.

sa: ततः समुद्रः स्वां वेलामतिक्रामति भारत। पर्वताश्च विदीर्यन्ते मही चाप्सु निमज्जति॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, the ocean then over-floods it bounds; the mountains fall down in fragments and the earth sinks under the increasing flood.

sa: देवेभ्योऽहं नमस्कृत्य सर्वेभ्यः पृथिवीपते। वृणे त्वामेव भर्तारं सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: O the ruler of the carth, to tell you the truth, I accept you for my lord after I have saluted all the celestials,

sa: इत्यनुस्मृत्य कृष्णं सा हरिं त्रिभुवनेश्वरम्। प्रारुदद् दुःखिता राजन् मुखमाच्छाद्य भामिनी॥
en: Vaishampayana said O king, thus being afflicted, the lady, covering her face, cried aloud thinking of Krishna (Hari), the lord of the three worlds.

sa: हा हताः स्मेति वाशन्त्यस्तीव्रशोकसमाहताः। रुदन्त्यः करुणं वापि गृहीत्वा दक्षिणे करे॥
en: They cried, "Alas! Oh!” And they were affected with great grief and they caught hold of Jantu by his right hand and wept piteously.

sa: वृद्धैः सम्मन्त्र्य सद्धिश्च बुद्धिमद्भिः श्रुतान्वितैः। आस्थितः शास्ति दण्डेन व्यसनी परिभूयते॥ निग्रहानुग्रहैः सम्यग् यदा राजा प्रवर्तते। तदा भवन्ति लोकस्य मर्यादा: सुव्यवस्थिताः॥
en: That king only is fit to govern who takes counsel of wise men, who is helped by honest, intelligent and learned ministers. But a sinful king always meets with defeat. When the king duly prescribes and properly confers favours, then only the order of the world is preserved.

sa: गुर्वर्थश्च कृतः पार्थ महाशत्रून् घनता मम। एवमेव सदा भाव्यं स्थिरेणाजौधनंजय॥
en: O Partha, you have (now) paid your preceptor's fees by slaying my powerful enemies. O Dhananjaya, you will, thus, ever remain cool-headed in battle,

sa: ततो वै ब्राह्मणीं गत्वा ब्रह्मचारी जितेन्द्रियः। पावर्णेन यानेन ब्रह्मलोकं प्रपद्यते॥
en: Then going to Brahmani with one's passions controlled and with Brahmacharya life, one goes to the region of Brahma on a lotus coloured car.

sa: शमनं सर्वभूतानां सर्वलोककृतोद्यमम्। एवं प्रणिहितः सम्यङ् ममात्मा मुनिसत्तम। सर्वभूतेषु विप्रेन्द्र न च मां वेत्ति कश्चन॥
en: O foremost of Rishis, I am the destroyer of all creatures and I am also the cause of all efforts of all creatures. My soul completely pervades all creatures. O chief of Brahmanas, none knows me.

sa: तेषां तु शरवर्षाणि सव्यसाची परंतपः। अस्त्रैः संवार्य तेजस्वी गन्धर्वान् प्रत्यविध्यत।॥
en: But that chastiser of foes, that greatly powerful Savyasachi (Arjuna), stopped that shower of weapons with his own weapons and began to wound them.

sa: अपृच्छच्चैव राजेन्द्र लोमशं पाण्डुनन्दनः। भगवन् किमर्थं रामस्य हृतमासीद् वपुः प्रभो। कथं प्रत्याहृतं चैव एतदाचक्ष्व पृच्छतः॥
en: O king of kings, the son of Pandu (Yudhishthira) then thus spoke to Lomasha, "O exalted one, for what reason Rama's effulgence was robbed? How did he again regain it? I ask you, tell me everything.

sa: अचिन्तयन्ममेदं ये रूपं द्रक्ष्यन्ति कानने। ते ब्राह्मणीनामनृतं दोषं वक्ष्यन्ति पावक॥
en: Then she thought that those who would see her in that disguise in the forest would speak ill of the Brahmana women and Agni.

sa: गतेषु पार्थिवेन्द्रेषु भीमः प्रीतो महामनाः॥ विवाहं कारयामास दमयन्त्या नलस्य च।
en: And after the departure of the best rulers of the earth, the lofty-minded and well-pleased Bhima celebrated the marriage ceremony of Damayanti and Nala.

sa: तत् तथा कृतवान् रामः कौन्तेय वचनात् पितुः। प्राप्तवांश्च पुनस्तेजस्तीर्थेऽस्मिन् पाण्डुनन्दन॥
en: O son of Kunti, Rama did all that his ancestors had said. O son of Pandu, he regained his lost effulgence in this Tirtha.

sa: विक्लवोऽसि मया ज्ञातस्ततस्ते दर्शितं जगत्। अभ्यन्तरं शरीरस्य प्रविष्टोऽसि यदा मम॥
en: You were afflicted with arrow. I knew this and it is for this reason I showed the universe when you entered within my body.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच संस्पृशन्निव सर्वास्ताः शिखाभिः काञ्चनप्रभाः। पश्यमानश्च मुमुदे गार्हपत्यं समाश्रितः॥
en: Thus transforming himself into a household fire Adbhuta fire was highly gratified with seeing those gold complexioned ladies and touching them with his flames.

sa: सर्वेषामेव भूतानां पिता माता च माधवः। गच्छध्वमेनं शरणं शरण्यं कौरवर्षभाः॥
en: This descendant of Madhu (Krishna) is the father and mother of all creatures, O foremost of the Kurus, take refuge in this great protector.

sa: शुश्रूषायां रताः शूद्रास्तथा वर्णत्रयस्य च। एषधर्मः कृतयुगे त्रेतायां द्वापरे तथा॥
en: The Shudras will be devoted to the service of the other three orders. Such will be the Dharma in Krita, Treta and Dvapara Yugas.

sa: तद् गच्छ विपुलप्रज्ञ भ्रातुः प्रियहिते रतः। अरिष्टं क्षेममध्वानं वायुना परिरक्षितः॥
en: O greatly wise one being intent on the welfare of your brothers and being protected by Vayu, go along a fortunate and blessed way.

sa: यो न यातयते वैरमल्पसत्त्वोद्यमः पुमान्। अफलं जन्म तस्याहं मन्ये दुर्जातजायिनः॥
en: The man, who being destitute of strength and courage, fails to chastise his enemies lives in vain. I consider such a man as low-born.

sa: तत: सूत उपागम्य दमयन्त्यै न्यवेदयत्। पौरजनो देवि द्वारि तिष्ठति कार्यवान्॥
en: Then the charioteer, having approached Damayanti, said to her" 'O auspicious one, all the citizens and the state officers are staying at the gate."

sa: अथापश्यत् स उदये भास्करं भास्करद्युतिः। सोमं चैव महाभागं विशमानं दिवाकरम्॥
en: That sun-like effulgent one then saw the sun on the Udaya (rising) mountain. He also saw the greatly exalted moon entering into the sun.

sa: यमौ च भीमसेनाश्च कृष्णा चामित्रकर्शन। सर्वे चात्र गमिष्यामस्त्वयैव सह पाण्डव॥
en: O son of Pandu, O chastiser of foes, the twins, Bhimasena and Krishna (Draupadi) and all of us will accompany you to this spot,

sa: गृहे भीमस्य नृपतेः परस्परसुखैषिणौ। वसेतां हृष्टसंकल्पौ वैदर्भी च नलश्च ह॥
en: Both the princess of Vidharbha and Nala began to dwell most happily in the palace of king Bhima, desirous to make each other happy.

sa: अर्चिताः सततं देवाः पुष्पैरद्भिः सदा च वः। यथालब्धैर्मूलफलैः पितरचापि तर्पिताः॥
en: We have worshipped the celestials with flowers and water, we have offered oblations to the Pitris with fruits and roots as were available there.

sa: तं शक्रं कश्मलाविष्टं दृष्ट्वा विष्णुः सनातनः। स्वतेजो व्यदधाच्छने बलमस्य विवर्धयन्॥
en: The eternal Vishnu, seeing Sakra (Indra) confounded with fear and grief, enhanced his prowess by importing to him a portion of his own might.

sa: अथास्य शैलशिखरं केशी क्रुद्धो व्यवासृजत्। तदा पतन्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य शैलशृङ्गं शतक्रतुः॥
en: Thereupon Keshin in great anger hurled upon Indra a large mass of rocks. Seeing that the mass of rocks was falling (upon him) Shatakratu.

sa: अनार्यकर्मन् कस्मात् त्वमिमां कन्यां जिहीर्षसि। वलिाणं मां विजानीहि विरमास्याः प्रबाधनात्॥
en: “Why are you insolently behaving towards this lady? Know that I am the wielder of thunder. Stop from doing any violence to this lady."

sa: ततोऽर्जुनो मुदं लेभे लब्धास्त्रः पुरुषर्षभः। कृतार्थमथ चात्मानं स मेने पूर्णमानसम्॥
en: Thereupon having obtained that weapon that best of men, Arjuna attained to delight; he then considered himself blessed and as having his desire fulfilled.

sa: रथो मातलिसंयुक्त आगन्ता त्वत्कृते महीम्। तत्र तेऽहं प्रदास्यामि दिव्यान्यस्त्राणि कौरव॥
en: The car, having Matali as its charioteer, shall come down to the earth for you; O Kaurava, I shall give you these celestials weapons."

sa: न चैषा तेजसा शक्या कैश्चिद्धर्षयितुं पथि। यशस्विनी महाभागा मद्भक्तेयं पतिव्रता॥
en: For her spiritedness, nobody will be able to insult, on the way, this high-souled, chaste and illustrious lady who is (fondly) devoted to me.'

sa: सातश्च कृतजप्यश्च ब्राह्मणान् स्वस्ति वाच्य च। ततो मेघवपुःप्रख्यं स्यन्दनं च सुकल्पितम्। योजयित्वा महाबाहुर्दारुकः समुपस्थितः॥ उपस्थितं रथं दृष्ट्वा तायप्रवरकेतनम्। प्रदक्षिणमुपावृत्य समारुह्य महामनाः॥ प्रययौ पुण्डरीकाक्षस्ततो द्वारवती पुरीम्॥
en: He performed his ablutions and went through the daily rites of worship. The Brahmanas uttered benedictions. Then the mighty armed Daruka came with the car of excellent make and the body resembling the clouds. Seeing that the Garuda-bannered car had arrived, the high-souled and lotus-eyed (Krishna) walked round it respectfully and ascending on it, started for the city of Dvaravati.

sa: अप्रमत्तः स्थितो नित्यं प्रजाः पाहि विशाम्पते। पर्जन्यमिव भूतानि महाद्रुममिव द्विजाः॥
en: "O kings, cherish your subjects with ceaseless vigilance and patience. As the clouds are to all creatures, as the large tree to the birds.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तथानुमन्त्रितास्तेनधर्मराजेन ताः प्रजाः। चक्रुरार्तस्वरं घोरं हा राजनिति संहताः॥
en: Vaishampayana said: Let your Having been thus exhorted by Dharmaraja (Yudhishthira), the subjects raised up all together a fearful wail, exclaiming “Alas, O king!”

sa: एते देवास्त्रयः कृत्स्नं त्रैलोक्यंधारयन्ति वै। विब्रुवन्तु यथा सत्यमेतद् देवास्त्यजन्तु माम्॥
en: Let the three gods, that preside over the whole of the three worlds, relate the whole history truly; or let them abandon me today.

sa: चन्द्रमाः सर्वभूतानामन्तश्चरति साक्षिवत्। स मुञ्चतु मम प्राणान् यदि पापं चराम्यहम्॥
en: Let the moon, that lives in the heart of all creatures as a witness, take away my life, if I have committed any sin.

sa: नन्दिन्यां च समासाद्य कूपं देवनिषेवितम्। नरमेधस्य यत् पुण्यं तदाप्नोति नराधिप॥
en: O best of kings! then going to the well of celestials in the Nandini tirtha, one gets the fruit equal to the Naramedha sacrifice.

sa: जानामि वीर्यं च जयात्मजस्य काणिर्भवत्येष यथा रणस्थः। साम्बः ससूतं सरथं भुजाभ्यां दुःखासनं शास्तु बलात् प्रमथ्य॥
en: I know the power of this son (of Krishna). I know how Krishna's son conducts himself in the field of battle. Samba will with great force chastise by his arms Dushashana with his charioteer and car.

sa: यं विषादोऽभिभवति विक्रमे समुपस्थिते। तेजसा तस्य हीनस्य पुरुषार्थो न विद्यते॥
en: That man has no manliness whose energies do abandon him and who is overpowered with perplexity, when an occasion for displaying vigour presents itself.

sa: तया शुश्रूषया सिद्धिं महत्त्वं समवाप्स्यसि। जातिस्मरश्च भविता स्वर्गं चैव गमिष्यसि॥
en: By (thus) serving them, you will acquire great success. You shall also remember the events of your past life and shall go to heaven.

sa: भिनत्ति शिरसा शैलमहिं भोजयते च यः। धीरेव कुरुते तस्य कार्याणामनुशासनम्। यो बलादनुशास्तीह सोऽमित्रं तेन विन्दति॥
en: He also breaks his head against a stonewall and he that feeds a serpent, is guided in those acts of his by his own reason. He who wants to control another by force becomes his enemy.

sa: पूर्वं प्राची दिशं राजन् राजर्षिगणसेविताम्। रम्यां ते कथयिष्यामि युधिष्ठिर यथास्मृति॥
en: O king, O Yudhishthira, I shall first speak of the charming eastern country ever frequented by the royal Rishis, as far as I recollect.

sa: तमापतन्तं बाणौघं स चिच्छेद महाबलः। ततश्चान्याञ्छरान् दीप्तान् प्रचिक्षेप सुते मम॥
en: That great warrior (my son) drove off that shower of arrows. Seeing this, he (Shalva) rained on my son other weapons of blazing splendour.

sa: ज्वालावर्णो देवदत्तो धनुष्मान् कवची शरी। मर्त्यधर्मतया तस्मादद्य मे साध्वसो महान्॥
en: Of celestial origin and of effulgence as that of fire, he was born with bow, arrows and armour. I have great fear from him.

sa: तथैव वृत्रस्य वधे संगृहीता हया मया। वैरोचनेर्महायुद्धं दृष्टं चापि सुदारुणम्॥
en: Again, I drove the horses on the occasion of Vritra's destruction and also witnessed that awful and terrible encounter with the son of Virochana.

sa: कादम्बैश्चक्रवाकैश्च कुररैर्जलकुक्कुटैः। कारण्डवैः प्लवैहसैर्बकैर्महगुभिरेव च॥
en: And teeming with Kadambas, Chakrabakas, Kuraras, waterfowls, Karandavas, Palavas, swans, cranes, Madgus,

sa: प्रहसन्ति स्म तां केचिदभ्यसूयन्ति चापरे। अकुर्वत दयां केचित् पप्रच्छुश्चापि भारत॥
en: Some laughed at her, some began to hate her. Some showed kindness towards her and some, O Bharata, questioned her in the following manner.

sa: एवं वर्णस्य वर्णस्य समुच्चीय सहस्रशः। यथा समुदिता वीराः सर्वे वीरपराक्रमाः॥
en: I have soldiers picked up by thousands from each order who are all brave and who are endued with the prowess of (great) heroes.

sa: ब्राह्मणाच विशश्चैव तथा विषयवासिनः। विसृज्यमानाः सुभृशं न त्यजन्ति स्म पाण्डवान्॥
en: Though the Brahmanas, the Vaishyas and the (other) inhabitants of his kingdom, were repeatedly requested to go, but they did not leave the Pandavas.

sa: ततः समभवन्नारी तस्या रूपेण सम्मिता। अवलुच्यापरां चापि जुहावाग्नौ जटां पुनः॥
en: Thereupon rose out of it a female exactly resemble his daughter-in-law. He then again tore off another lock and offered it to the fire.

sa: मन्वानस्तं मृगं चाहं सम्प्राप्तः सहसा प्रभो। अपश्यं तमृषि विद्धं शरेणानतपर्वणा॥
en: O lord, taking him for a deer I soon went near him and saw that Rishi pierced by my that arrow with head bent.

sa: निर्गस्य चन्द्रोदयने विगाढे रजनीमुखे। प्रस्थिता सा पृथुश्रोणी पार्थस्य भवनं प्रति॥
en: Starting at the time when the moon rose and the twilight deepened, that lady of high hips went towards the abode of Partha (Arjuna).

sa: ततो विचार्य बहुशो रथमार्गेषु तान् हयान्। प्राचोदयत् समे देशे मातलिर्भरतर्षभ॥
en: Then O best of the Bharatas, deliberately judging of the course the car should take, Matali began to drive the steeds on level grounds,

sa: त्वया हि पृथिवी राजन् रक्ष्यमाणा महात्मना। भविष्यति निरुद्विग्ना नारण्यं गन्तुमर्हसि॥
en: O king, the earth, being protected by your august self, will be freed from all anxieties. Therefore you should not retire into the forest.

sa: अवध्यो दैवतानां हि दैत्यानामथ रक्षसाम्॥ नागानामथ यक्षाणां गन्धर्वाणां च सर्वशः। अवाप्य स वरं राजन् सर्वलोकपितामहात्॥
en: O king, he has become incapable of being killed by the celestials, the Daityas, the Rakshasas, the Nagas, the Yakshas and the Gandharvas for his obtaining. O king, a boon from the Grandsire of all creatures.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाचत तमुवाच महातेजाः प्रहस्यवृषभध्वजः। प्रगृह्य रुचिरं बाहुं क्षान्तमित्येव फाल्गुनम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : The greatly effulgent Vrishabdhvaja (Shiva), taking hold of the handsome hands of Arjuna, smilingly said to him, “I have pardoned you."

sa: सैषा सागरमासाद्य राजन् वेदी समाश्रिता। एतामारुह्य भद्रं ते त्वमेकस्तर सागरम्॥
en: O king, this is that sacred altar stretching as far as the sea; be blessed by ascending it; and of yourself cross the sea.

sa: शरण्यं शरणं गत्वा भगवन्तं पिनाकिनम्। मृन्मयं स्थण्डिलं कृत्वा माल्येनापूजयद् भवम्॥
en: Mentally bowing before the exalted deity of the Pinaka and making a clay image of that deity, he worshipped it with garlands of flowers.

sa: स काल्यमानो घोरेण शूलहस्तेन रक्षसा। अग्निहोत्रं पितुर्भीत: सहसा प्रविवेश ह॥
en: Being pursued by the fearful Rakshasha with the uplifted spear, he in great fear, tried to enter his father's room of the sacred fire.

sa: वस्तु देवमनुष्येषु प्रख्यातः सहजैर्गुणैः। श्रिया शीलेन रूपेण व्रतेन च दमेन च। प्रख्यातो बलवीर्येण सम्मतः प्रतिभानवान्॥
en: He, who is known among good men for his grace, behaviour, beauty, vows and selfcontrol, who is famous for his might and prowess, who is respected by the pious, who is endued with presence of mind.

sa: देवा महर्षयश्चापि स्वानि स्थानानि भेजिरे। तस्य पुत्रास्त्रयः शिष्टा युधिष्ठिर तदाभवन्॥
en: The celestials as well as the great sages departed to their respective residences. O Yudhishthira, then the king (Kuvalashva) had still three son left.

sa: राजन् परीतया बुद्ध्या विषमेऽक्षपराजये। राज्यं वसून्यायुधानि भ्रातृन् मां चासि निर्जितः॥
en: O king, by your perverse understanding, in your defeat at the gambling match you lost your kingdom, wealth, weapons your brothers and even myself.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः पराजिताः पार्था वनवासाय दीक्षिताः। अजिनान्युत्तरीयाणि जगृहुश्च यथाक्रमम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thereupon the vanquished sons of Pritha, preparing for their exile in the forest, attired themselves in deer skins and Uttriya (upper garment).

sa: अन्यायोपगतं द्रव्यमभीक्ष्णं यो हपण्डितः। धर्माभिशंकी यजते न स धर्मफलं लभेत्॥
en: That person of little intelligence, who, from desire of acquiring merit, celebrates sacrifices with wealth acquired by unfair means, never succeeds in acquiring merit.

sa: निवर्तनं च तत्रास्य त्रीणि पद्यानि वै विभुः। दिवसे यश्चतुर्थे तु प्राश्नीयादेकभोजनम्॥ सदा द्वादशमासान् वै जुह्वानो जातवेदसम्। वाजपेयस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमम्॥
en: Fasting for three days successively, he who takes only one meal every fourth day, and pours libations every day on his sacred fire, acquires the great merit of the Vajapeya sacrifice. The car he acquires is graced by highly beautiful celestial ladies who have Indra for their father.

sa: ततः स पुनरावर्त्य हयः कामचरो बली। आससाद पुरीरम्यां चेदीनां शुक्तिसाह्वयाम्॥
en: Turning round in course of his wanderings at will, the strong horse came upon the beautiful city of the Chedis called after the oyster.

sa: तं वै वधूः स्थिता साध्वी ब्राह्मणप्रियकाम्यया। सक्तूनादाय संहृष्टा श्वशुरं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥ संतानात् तव संतानं मम विप्र भविष्यति। सक्तूनिमानतिथये गृहीत्वा सम्प्रयच्छ मे॥
en: Desirous of doing what was agreeable to him, his chaste daughter-in-law then, bearing her share of the barley, approached him and said, Through your son, O learned Brahmana, I shall obtain a son. Do you, therefore, take my share of the barley and give it to this guest.

sa: पितोवाच अपि वर्षसहस्री त्वं बाल एव मतो मम। उत्पाद्य पुत्रं हि पिता कृतकृत्यो भवेत् सुतात्॥
en: The Father said If you attain to the age of even a thousand year, You will still seem to me to be only a little child. Having begotten a son, the father achieves success through him.

sa: विमुक्तः सर्वसङ्गेषु स्नेहबन्धेषु च द्विजः। आत्मन्येवात्मनो भावं समासज्जेत वै द्विजः॥
en: He is freed from every attachment, and from every bond of affection. He merges the existence of his own soul into the Supreme Soul.

sa: सर्ववृत्तान्ततवत्ज्ञो भवान् दिव्येन चक्षुषा। युक्तः पश्यसि विप्रर्षे गतिर्या विविधा नृणाम्॥
en: You know the truth of every affair. Gifted with celestial vision, you behold, O twice-born Rishi, what the various ends are of human beings.

sa: व्यक्षरस्तु भवेन्मृत्युस्त्र्यक्षरं ब्रह्म शाश्वतम्। ममेति च भवेन्मृत्युन ममेति च शाश्वतम्॥
en: Of two syllables is Mrityu (death); of three syllable is the eternal Brahma Mineness is death, and the opposite of mineness is the eternal.

sa: ददत् स तादृशानां वै नरो गां पापकर्मणाम्। अक्षयं नरकं यातीत्येवमाहुर्महर्षयः॥
en: The wise have said that the person, who gives away the cow to any of such sinful persons, has to sink in eternal Heli.

sa: एवं रूपाणि सततं कुरुते पाकशासनः॥ तस्माद् विपुल यत्नेन रक्षेमां तनुमध्यमाम्।
en: The chastiser of Paka always assumes these disguises. Do you therefore, O Vipula protect this slender-waisted wife of mine with great care. intent upon

sa: पद्मोत्पलविमिश्राणां ह्रदानामिव शीतलः। गन्धोऽस्य स कदम्बानां तुल्यो वै तपतां वर॥
en: O foremost of all persons gifted with penances, the fragrance of it resembles the cool perfume that is scattered by lakes adorned with lotuses.

sa: इन्द्रियाणि च सर्वाणि वाजिवत् परिपालय। हितायैव भविष्यन्ति रक्षित द्रविणं यथा॥
en: You should always keep your senses as you keep your horses. They will then prove beneficial to you, like riches that is not wasted.

sa: वृकोदरकृते चाहमर्जुनश्च पुनः पुनः। प्रसीद याचे नृपते भवान् प्रभुरिहास्ति यत्॥ तद् ददातु भवान् वित्तं यावदिच्छसि पार्थिव। त्वमीश्वरोऽस्य राज्यस्य प्राणानामपि भारत॥
en: Both myself and Arjuna, O king, repeatedly beg you for pardoning Vrikodara. Be gracious to us. You are our lord, O king, you can give away as you like whatever money we have. You, O Bharata, are the master of this kingdom and of all lives in it.

sa: मोहमेव नियच्छन्ति कर्मणा ज्ञानवर्जिताः। नैष्कर्म्यं न च लोकेऽस्मिन् मुहूर्तमपि लभ्यते॥
en: Those persons who are destitute of knowledge, only store delusion by deeds. Freedom from acts, again, cannot even be momentarily attained in this world.

sa: तेषां तेजस्तथा वीर्यं देवानां ववृधे ततः। अवाप्नुवंश्चामरत्वं त्रिषु लोकेषु पूजितम्॥
en: The energy and prowess of the celestials then began to increase, and adored in all the worlds, they acquired also the boon of immortality.

sa: जलजानि च माल्यानि पद्मादीनि च यानि वै। गन्धर्वनागयक्षेभ्यस्तानि दद्याद् विचक्षणः॥
en: A wise man should offer garlands red of aquatic flowers, such as the lotus and the like, to the Gandharvas and Nagas and Yakshas.

sa: ततो राजा जातरूपस्य राशीन् पदे पदे कारयामास हृष्टः। द्विजातिभ्यो विसृजन् भूरि वित्तं रराज वित्तेश इवारिहन्ता॥
en: Then that king, the destroyer of his enemies, with a delighted heart, placed heaps of gold on various spots, and distributing the immense riches to the Brahmanas, he looked glorious like Kubera the King of Riches.

sa: अर्थश्च सुमहान् प्राप्तो येन यक्ष्यामि देवताः। पुरस्कृत्याद्य भवतः समानेष्यामहे मखम्॥
en: And likewise, I have attained great riches, with which I may adore the celestials, therefore, with your help, I shall now celebrate the sacrifice.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच उपपत्त्या यतिस्तूष्णीं वर्तमानस्ततः परम्। अध्वर्युरपि निर्मोहः प्रचचार महामखे।॥
en: The Brahmana said With this conclusion, the Yati remained silent after this. The Adhvaryu also went on with the great sacrifice, freed from delusion.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा नकुलः सर्वान् यज्ञे द्विजवरांस्तदा॥ जगामादर्शनं तेषां विप्रास्ते च ययुर्ग्रहान्॥
en: Having said those words to all those foremost of Brahmanas, the mungoose disappeared from their view. Those Brahmanas then returned to their respective homes.

sa: पुरूरवसमैलं च त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्। बुधस्य दयितं पुत्रं कीर्तयेद् वसुधाधिपम्॥
en: He was the son of Ila and celebrated over the three worlds. One should, indeed, take the name of that dear son of Budha.

sa: गतिरेषा तु मुक्तानां ये ज्ञानपरिनिष्ठिताः। प्रवृत्तयश्च याः सर्वाः पश्यन्ति परिणामजाः॥
en: This is the end of those liberated ones who are intent on knowledge. They sees all those movements which are born of successive developments.

sa: तामपश्यन्निपतितां वसुदेवः क्षितौ तदा। दृष्ट्वैव च पपातोळें सोऽपि दुःखेन मूर्छितः॥
en: Vasudeva saw his daughter fallen on the ground. As soon as he saw this, he also fell down, deprived of his senses by grief.

sa: शुचयः सक्तवश्चमे नियमोपार्जिताः प्रभो। प्रतिगृह्णीष्व भद्रं ते मया दत्ता द्विजर्षभ॥
en: Here is some clean Saktu acquired by lawful means, O powerful one! Given by us, O foremost of twice-born persons, do you accept it.

sa: धूपप्रदानस्य फलं प्रदीपस्य तथैव च। बलयश्च किमर्थं वै क्षिप्यन्ते गृहमेधिभिः॥
en: Indeed, tell me. O Sire once more of the merits of presenting incense and lights. Why Balis offered the ground by householders. are on

sa: अभिगम्य भृगोः पुत्रं च्यवनं संशितव्रतम्। इदं प्रोवाच नृपते वाचा संतर्पयन्निव॥
en: Proceeding then to Bhrigu's son Chyavana of rigid vows, he addressed him thus O monarch, for satisfying him to the best of his power.

sa: नियमानां फलं राजन् प्रत्यक्षमिह दृश्यते। नियमानां क्रतूनां च त्वयावाप्तमिदं फलम्॥
en: The fruits of restraints, O king, are visible even in this world. These rewards that you have acquired are those of Niyamas and sacrifices.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तौ मरुत्तः स नारदेन महर्षिणा। विप्रलम्भमुपाध्यायात् सर्वमेव न्यवेदयत्॥
en: Vaishampayana continued : Thus addressed by the great Rishi Narada, king Marutta informed him of the refusal he had received from his religious preceptor.

sa: साऽहं गन्तुमभीप्सामि पुरीं द्वारावती प्रति। रोचतां गमनं मह्यं तवापि पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: And now I am desirous of going to the city of Dvaravati. Do you, therefore, O most courageous of me, assent to my departure.

sa: उमोवाच वाहनेष्वत्र सर्वेषु श्रीमत्स्वन्येषु सत्तम। कथं च वृषभो देव वाहनत्वमुपागतः॥
en: Uma said When, O foremost of all creatures, there are so many excellent beautiful cars, why have you selected a bull for your vehicle?

sa: असृजत् सर्वभूतानि पूर्वदृष्टः प्रजापतिः। स्थावराणि च भूतानि इत्येषा पौर्विकी श्रुतिः॥
en: Seen first (to appear in an embodied form). Prajapati (then) created all the primal elements and all immobile creatures. This is the ancient Shruti.

sa: राजकार्येषु पुरा व्यासक्ता नित्यशोऽभवन्। ते राजकार्याणि तदा नाकार्षुः सर्वतः पुरे।॥
en: They who had formerly been always engaged in royal offices, did not at that time attend to those deeds at all in their capital.

sa: उत्तरा हि पुरोक्तं वै कथयत्यरिसूदन। अभिमन्योर्वचः कृष्ण प्रियत्वात् तन्न संशयः॥
en: Uttara, O destroyer of enemies, always repeats the words said to her by Abhimanyu. Forsooth, O Krishna, those words were highly agreeable to her.

sa: पुल्कसः पापयोनिर्वा यः कश्चिदिह लक्ष्यते। स तस्यामेव सुचिरं मतङ्ग परिवर्तते॥
en: Verily, one having taken birth in that sinful caste, viz., Pulkasa, one, O Matanga, has to wander in it for a very long time.

sa: स तान् दृष्ट्वा तथा छिन्नांस्तोमरान् भगदत्तजः। इषूनसक्तांस्त्वरितः प्राहिणोत् पाण्डवं प्रति॥
en: The son of Bhagadatta, seeing his broadheaded arrows thus cut off, quickly sped at Arjuna a number of other arrows in a continuous line.

sa: शुक्रात् संजायते चापि रसादपि च जायते। एतद् रूपमुदानस्य हर्षो मिथुनमन्तरा॥
en: Pleasure originates from the semen as well. It arises from taste also. This is the form (effect) of Udana. Pleasure is produced from union.

sa: बृहस्पतिस्तु तां श्रुत्वा मरुत्तस्य महीपतेः। समृद्धिपतिदेवेभ्य: संतापमकरोद् भृशम्॥ स तप्यमानो वैवयं कृशत्वं चागमत् परम्। भविष्यति हि मे शत्रुः संवर्तो वसुमानिति॥
en: And hearing of the prosperity of Marulta, eclipsing that of the gods, Brihaspati, too, became grcatly sorry at heart and, distressed at the thought that his rival Samvarta should become prosperous, became sick at heart, and the glow of his complexion left him, and his body became emaciated.

sa: नानाभावास्तथैकत्वं शरीरं प्राप्य संहताः। भवन्ति ते तथा नित्याः पृथग्भावं विजानताम्॥
en: Various existent objects, attaining to a body, become united as one. Those very objects become eternal to men of knowledge who understand the difference.

sa: किमर्थं ते ललाटे वै तृतीयं नेत्रमुत्थितम्। किमर्थं च गिरिर्दग्धः सपक्षिगणकाननः॥
en: Why has this third eye appeared in your forehead? Why also the mountain consumed with the forests and all that belonged was to it?

sa: राजा तान् स्वरयोगेन स्पर्शेन च महामनाः। प्रत्यभिज्ञाय मेधावी समाश्वासयत प्रभुः॥
en: The powerful and the great monarch, gifted with great intelligence, recognising them by their voices ard also by touch, comforted them one after another.

sa: एवमेतद् भवेत् सत्यं यथैतन्मन्यते भवान्। ऋतेऽस्मानस्मादर्थोस्त्वं भोगान् भुङ्क्ते भवान् यदि।।
en: Hearing these words, the Senses said, This what you think would be true, if, you could enjoy pleasures without either ourselves or our objccts.

sa: यूपेषु नियता चासीत् पशूनां त्रिशती तथा। अश्वरत्नोत्तरा यज्ञे कौन्तेयस्य महात्मनः॥
en: In that sacrifice of the great son of Kunti, three hundred animals were tied to the stakes set up, including that foremost of horses.

sa: इति मामब्रवीद् राजा पार्थश्चैव धनंजयः। यदत्रानन्तरं कार्यं तद् भवान् वक्तुमर्हति॥
en: These were the words said to me by the king as also by Pritha's son Dhananjaya. You should say what should be done next.

sa: गङ्गायास्तीरमाश्रित्य हते शान्तनवे नृप॥ आप्लुत्य देवा वसवः समेत्य च महानदीम्। इदमूचुर्वचो घोरं भागीरथ्या मते तदा॥ एष शान्तनवो भीष्मो निहतः सव्यसाचिना।
en: After the fall of Shantanu's son, those celestials, viz., the Vasus, coming to the banks of Ganga, bathed in her waters, and calling the goddess of that stream, they uttered these terrible words having the sanction of Bhagirati herself, viz., Shantanu's son Bhishma has been killed by Dhananjaya.

sa: उपलब्धा द्विजश्रेष्ठ तथेयं सिद्धिरुत्तमाः इतः परं गमिष्यामि ततः परतरं पुनः॥
en: Having acquired this excellent success, I shall, after departing from this world, proceed to what is above it and thence to what is higher.

sa: इत्युक्तः स द्विजः प्राह तथास्त्विति नराधिपम्। एवं समभवंस्तस्य वरास्ते दीप्ततेजसः॥
en: Thus addressed, that Brahman, replied to the king, saying, So let it be! thus were those boons acquired by that king of burning effulgence.

sa: त्वष्टाधिराजो रूपाणां पशूनामीश्वरः शिवः॥ दीक्षितानां तथा यज्ञो दैवानां मघवा तथा।
en: Tvashtri is the king of Rudras, and Shiva of all creatures. Sacrifice is the foremost of all initiatory rites and Maghavat of the celestials.

sa: अत्र ते वर्तयिष्यामि पुरावृत्तमिदं नृप। द्वैपायनस्य संवादं कीटस्य च युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Regarding it, О king, I shall explain to you the old discourse that took place formerly between the Dvaipayana Rishi and a crawling worm.

sa: सर्वे हि भस्मसान्नीतास्ते द्रोणेन रणाजिरे. अवशिष्टाश्च निहता द्रोणपुत्रेण वै निशि॥
en: All of them have been reduced to ashes by Drona on the field of battle. The remnant were killed by Drona's son at night.

sa: दानं व्रतं ब्रह्मचर्यं यथोक्तं ब्रह्मधारणम्। दमः प्रशान्तता चैव भूतानां चानुकम्पनम्॥ संयमाश्चानृशंस्यं च परस्वादानवर्जनम्। व्यलोकानामकरणं भूतानां मनसा भुवि॥ ततस्तु क्षीयते चैव मातापित्रोश्च शुश्रूषा देवतातिथिपूजनम्। गुरुपूजा घृणा शौचं नित्यमिन्द्रियसंयमः॥ प्रवर्तनं शुभानां च तत् सतां वृत्तमुच्यते। ततो धर्मः प्रभवति यः प्रजाः पाति शाश्वतीः॥
