en: Gifts, observances of austerity, celibacy, bearing Brahma according to the ordinances laid down, self-control, tranquility, mercy for all creatures, restraint of passions, abstention from cruelty as also from appropriating others properties, refraining from doing even mentally all deeds that are false and injurious to living creatures on the Earth, respectfully serving mother and father, honouring the celestials and guests, adoration of preceptors, pity, purity, constant control of all organs, and causing of all good deeds are said to form the conduct of the good. From observance of such conduct, originates virtue which protects all creatures eternally.

sa: अत्र ते वर्तयिष्यामि यथाधर्मं यथाश्रुतम्। इन्द्रस्य सह वृत्रेण यथा युद्धमवर्तत॥
en: I shall (therefore) relate to you truly as I have heard it, the story of the war of Indra with Vritra as It happened.

sa: धृतराष्ट्रादनु च ते गान्धारी सुबलात्मजाम्॥ कुन्ती च राजशार्दूल तदा भरतसत्तम।
en: Those foremost ones of Bharata's race, O chief of kings, then paid their respectful salutations to Gandhari, the daughter of Subala, and to Kunti.

sa: अतीतानागते चोभे पितृवशं च भारत। तारयेद् वृक्षरोपी च तस्माद् रोपयेत्॥
en: The man who plants trees rescues the ancestors and descendants of both his paternal and maternal lines. Do you, therefore, plant trees, O Yudhishthira.

sa: सच्चासच्चैव तद् द्वन्द्वं तयोर्मध्ये हुताशनः। एतद् रूपमुदानस्य परमं ब्राह्मणा विदुः॥
en: The existent and the non-existent form a pair. Between them is the Fire. That is the excellent scat of Udana as the Brahmanas know.

sa: तस्माद् गावो न पादेन स्प्रष्टव्या वै कदाचन। ब्राह्मणश्च महातेजा दीप्यमानस्तथानलः॥ श्रद्वधानेन मर्येन आत्मनो हितमिच्छता। एते दोषा मया प्रोक्तास्त्रिषु यः पादमुत्सृजेत्॥
en: One should, therefore, never touch a cow with his feet or a Brahmana of high energy or a burning fire, if he is gifted with faith and seeks his own behoof. These are the demerits declared by me of one who lifts up his feet towards these three.

sa: इत्येतद् वचनं श्रुत्वा जानानाहं बलं तव। प्रसादये त्वां दुर्धर्ष जीवतामभिमन्युजः॥
en: Hearing these words of yours and wellknowing your power, I seek to gratify you, O irresistible hero! Let the son of Abhimanyu be revived.

sa: कथाश्चक्रुस्ततस्ते तु मधुरा धर्मसंहिताः। राजर्षीणां सुराणां च ये वसन्ति तपोधनाः॥
en: Thus seated, they began to converse sweetly with one another on subjects of Religion and Duty as also with many royal sages and celestials.

sa: एकनिश्चयकार्याश्च व्यचरन्त वनानि ते। आददानाः समुद्धृत्य मूलानि च फलानि च॥
en: Indeed, they travelled through that forest, all bent upon a common object, viz., the plucking of fruits and the extraction of roots for maintenance.

sa: बृहस्पतिरुवाच एतत् ते सर्वमाख्यातं आसन्नमात्रः पुरुषस्तैर्भूतैरभिभूयते। विप्रयुक्तश्च तैर्भूतैः पुनर्यात्यपरां गतिम्॥ सर्वभूतसमायुक्तः प्राप्नुते जीव एव हि।
en: Brihaspati said As soon as individual soul enters the vital seed, he becomes overwhelmed by the elements already mentioned. When individual soul become disunited therewith, he is said to attain to the other end (viz., death).

sa: इत्युक्तः स तथेत्युक्त्वा भगवान् हव्यवाहनः। जगामाथ दुराधर्षो गङ्गां भागीरथी प्रति॥
en: Thus addressed, the illustrious and irresistible bearer of sacrificial libations answered, saying, Be it so! and he then proceeded towards Ganga otherwise called Bhagirathi.

sa: तथा कथयतां तेषां देवराजः पुरंदरः॥ ववर्ष सुमहातेजा दृष्ट्वा तस्य तपोबलम्।
en: As they were saving these words, Purandara, the king of the deities, gifted with great energy, seeing the power of Agastya's penances, poured rain.

sa: यथा लोहस्य नि:स्यन्दो निषिक्तो बिम्बविग्रहम्। उपैति तद् विजानीहि गर्भे जीवप्रवेशनम्॥
en: As liquefied iron, poured (into a mould), takes the form of the mould, so is the entrance of the Individual Soul into the foetus.

sa: उक्तं स देवतानां हि अवध्य इति पार्थिव। कथं तस्याभवन्मृत्युर्विस्तरेण प्रकीर्तय॥
en: You have, said, O king, that Asura had become unslayable by the gods. Do you tell me fully how his destruction was brought about.

sa: रसानां चाथ बीजानां धान्यानां च युधिष्ठिर। स्वयमुत्पाद्य दातारः पुरुषाः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those who having themselves manufactured drinks of sweet taste and seeds and paddy or rice, give them to others, succeed in ascending to heaven.

sa: यदि नोत्तिष्ठति जयः पिता मे नरसत्तमः। अस्मिन्नेव रणोद्देशे शोषयिष्ये कलेवरम्॥
en: If this best of men, Jaya, my father does not rise up, I shall emaciate my own body, sitting on the field of battle.

sa: अतीत दुःखसंतप्ता न शमं चोपलेभिरे। तथैव पाण्डवा वीरा नगरे नागसाह्वये॥
en: Greatly stricken with grief, they could find no comfort. The same was the case with the sons of Pandu in the city of Hastinapure.

sa: ततस्ते मुनयो हृष्टा ददृशुस्तपसो बलम्। विस्मिता वचनं प्राहुरिदं सर्वे महार्थवत्॥
en: The Rishis who were there saw the power of penances with rejoicing hearts. Filled with wonder they then said these words of grave significance.

sa: शिर:कपाले चास्यैव युञ्जतः पितुरद्य मे। प्रायश्चितं हि नास्त्यन्यद्वन्वाऽद्य पितरं मम॥
en: Give me the two halves of my sire's head today, for there is no other expiation for me who have killed my own father.

sa: अभिमानः श्रियं हन्ति पुरुषस्याल्पमेधसः। गर्भेण दुष्यते कन्या गृहवासेन च द्विजः॥
en: Pride destroys the prosperity of persons of little wit. A maiden, if she conceives, becomes stained. A Brahmana incurs reproach by remaining at home.

sa: स कदाचिन्मनुं विप्रो ददर्शोपससर्प च। कुशलप्रश्नमन्योन्यं तौ चोभौ तत्र चक्रतुः॥
en: One day that learned Brahmana beheld Manu, the lord of all creatures, and approached him. Meeting each other, they made the usual polite enquires.

sa: जरापरिगतो वृद्धः क्षुधार्तो दुर्बलो भृशम्॥ उपवास परिश्रान्तो यदा त्वमपि कर्शितः।
en: Overcome by decrepitude, you are of advanced years. Afflicted by hunger, you are greatly weakened. Worn out with fasts, you are very much emaciated.

sa: इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य सोऽथ तं वरुणोऽब्रवीत्॥ ममैषा सुप्रिया भार्यां नैनामुत्स्रष्टुमुत्सहे।
en: Hearing these words of Narada, Varuna replied to him, saying, This timed girl is very dear to me. I dare not let her go.

sa: राजपुत्रो महाबाहुः श्यामो राजीवलोचनः। अभिमन्योः पिता वीरः स एनं पालयिष्यति॥
en: son This mighty-armed prince, of dark colour, is endued with eyes resembling lotus petals. That hero, the father of Abhimanyu, will protect the horse,

sa: दृष्ट्वा तोयं सरस्वत्या मुनिभिस्तैस्तथा कृतम्॥ तानेव शरणं जम्मू राक्षसाः क्षुधितास्तथा।
en: Beholding the water of Sarasvati purified by those ascetics, the Rakshasas (that lived there), stricken with hunger, sought the protection of those ascetics themselves.

sa: इहैव फलमासीनः प्रत्याकाङ्क्षेत सर्वशः। ये ये नो न प्रदास्यन्ति तांस्तांस्तेनाभियास्यसि॥
en: Living here, you shall acquire the fruits of your valour. Troops will be sent against those who will refuse to give us our dues.

sa: ततः समुपविष्टेषु तेषु राजसु भारत। विवेश रङ्गं सा कन्या धात्रीवर्षवरान्विता॥
en: After all those kings had taken their seats, O Bharata, the maiden entered the arena, accompanied by her nurse and a guard of eunuchs.

sa: तथैव पाण्डवं सैन्यं शरै राजन् समन्ततः॥ रणेऽहन्यत पुत्रैस्ते शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः।
en: Similarly, the Pandava army, O king, were killed in hundreds and thousands in that battle by your sons on every side with their arrows.

sa: अनपेक्ष्यैव पितरं गाङ्गेयं विदुरं तथा। असंशयं क्षयं राजा यथैवाहं तथा गतः॥ अनियम्याशुचिं लुब्धं पुत्रं कामवशानुगम्।
en: Forsooth, by disregarding Vidura and the great son of Ganga, and neglecting to restrain his wicked and covetous son entirely under the influence of his passion, the king has met with destruction like my poor self.

sa: हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि शृण्वानस्य नराधिप। अभिषेकं कुमारस्य प्रभावं च महात्मनः॥
en: I shall describe to you the appointment of Kumara and the prowess of that high-souled one, since, O king, you wish to hear it.

sa: इति राष्ट्रे परिपतन् बहुभिः पुरुषैः सह। सर्वेषां राजयुक्तानां दुष्करं परिदृष्टवान्॥
en: Proclaiming this in the kingdom, the sage, accompanied by a large number of men, began to mark the misdeeds of all the state officers.

sa: क्षमा वै साधुमायाति न ह्यसाधूक्षमा सदा। क्षमायाश्चाक्षमायाश्च पार्थ विद्धि प्रयोजनम्॥
en: Forgiveness always comes to the good. It never comes to the bad. Listen now, O Partha, to the uses of forgiveness and of hardness.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा स तु तुष्टाव वचोभिर्वै महानदीम्॥ प्रीतः परमहृष्टात्मा यथावच्छृणु पार्थिव।
en: Having said to that great river, the sage, pleased and filled with joy, then praised her in these words. Hear them duly, O king!

sa: न हि पैधानिसस्त: कर्न चाप्यपराधजम्। शाम्यत्यदग्ध्वा नृपते विना टेकतर६. पात्॥
en: The fire of eninity, once lighted.-the result of an injury once inflicted,-is never extinguished, O king, without destroying the right one of the parties.

sa: इदानीं तु विशीर्णोऽयं दग्धो ब्रह्मास्त्रतेजा। भया विमुक्तः कौन्तेय त्वय्यद्य कृतकर्मणि।॥
en: Previously consumed by the power of Brahma weapons, it has been reduced to ashes upon my leaving it after you had achieved your object.

sa: उपह्वरे निवसतो यस्याङ्के निषसाद ह। गङ्गा भागीरथी तस्मादुर्वशी चाभवत् पुरा॥
en: Ganga, named (from before) Bhagirathi sat upon the lap of this king living near (her stream), and therefore, passed by the name of Urvashi.

sa: प्रन्नुतासि महाभागे सरसो ब्रह्मणः पुरा॥ जानान्ति त्वां सरिच्छेष्ठे मनुयः संशितव्रताः।
en: Thou hast sprung, O highly blessed one, from the lake of Brahman in days of old. All ascetics know thee, O best of rivers.

sa: नान्योऽन्येन विवादोऽभूत् स्त्रीणामपि कुतो नृणाम्। धर्मनित्याः प्रजाश्चासन् रामे राज्यं प्रशासति॥
en: Even the women did not quarrel with one another, what to speak of men? During his reign his subjects were always devoted to virtue.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच हतपुत्रो हतामात्यो हतसर्वसुहज्जनः। दुःखं नूनं भविष्यामि विचरन् पृथिवीमिमाम्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Deprived as I am of sons, counselors and all my friends, I shall, forsooth, have to rove about sorrowfully over the Earth.

sa: हयाः पञ्चशताः शिष्टाः शकुनेः सौबलस्य च॥ रथानां तु जनार्दन। दन्तिनां च शतं साग्रं त्रिसाहस्राः पदातयः॥
en: Only five hundred cavalry constitute the army of Shakuni the son of Subala. Only two hundred still remain, of cars, O Janarddana. Of elephants the only remnant is a hundred and of foot only three thousand.

sa: शक्र उवाच किं स्विदेकपदं ब्रह्मन् पुरुषः सम्यगाचरन्। प्रमाणं सर्वभूतानां यशश्चैवाप्नुयान्महत्॥
en: What is that one act, O twice-born one, by finishing which with care, a person may be respected by all creatures and become famous.

sa: नारायणं नमस्कृत्य नरं चैव नरोत्तमम्। देवी सरस्वतीं व्यासं ततो जयमुदीरयेत्।
en: Having saluted the Supreme Deity (Narayana) and the highest of all male beings (Nara) and the goddess of learning (Sarasvati) let us cry success.

sa: हीयमानेन वै सन्धिः पर्येष्टव्यः समेन वा। विग्रहो वर्धमानेन मतिरेषा बृहस्पतेः॥
en: He that is being weakened should seek peace by conciliation. He that is prosperous should make war. This is the policy taught by Brihaspati.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तः स कृष्णेन सर्वं नित्यं जनाधिप। उवाच देवकीपुत्रं धृतराष्ट्रो महीपतिः॥ एवमेतन्महाबाहो यथा वदसि माधव। पुत्रस्नेहस्तु बलवान् धैर्यान्मां समचालयत्॥
en: After he had thus been told the truth by Krishna, O king, Dhritarashtra replied to Devaki's son, saying. 'It is just so, O you of mighty arms! What you say, O Madhava, is perfectly truth! It is father's affection that made me deviate from the path of righteousness.

sa: दुर्योधनो न तं वेद पीडितं पाण्डवं रणे। धारयामास भीमोऽपि शरीरमतिपीडितम्॥
en: Duryodhana, however, could not perceive that Pandu's son was so afflicted at that moment. Though deeply afflicted, Bhima kept himself, summoning all his patience.

sa: महादेवस्ततस्तस्मिन् वृत्ते यज्ञे यथाविधि। दण्डं धर्मस्य गोप्तारं विष्णवे सत्कृतं ददौ॥
en: Upon the completion of that sacrifice according to due rites, Mahadeva after making proper reverence handed over Punishment, that protector of Righteousness, to Vishnu.

sa: तस्य यज्ञस्य सम्पत्या तुतुषुर्देवता अपि। विस्मयं परमं जग्मुः किमु मानुषयोनयः॥
en: The provisions collected in that sacrifice satisfied the very celestials. What shall I say then of men? The very celestials were filled with wonder.

sa: सामान्या निष्कृतिः प्राज्ञ यो मोक्षात् प्रत्यनन्तरम्॥१४७। कृतं मृगयसे शत्रु सुखोपायमसंशयम्।
en: O highly wise one, his escape is very difficult, who, immediately after he is freed from danger, seeks the means of his enemy's happiness.

sa: अर्थयुक्त्या हि जायन्ते पिता माता सुतस्तथा॥ मातुला भागिनेयाश्च तथा सम्बन्धिबान्धवाः।
en: The father, the mother, the son, the maternal uncle, the sister's son, and other relatives and kinsmen, are all moved by interest and profit.

sa: यथा मृगपतिर्नित्यं प्रकाइक्षति वनौकसः। तथैव स महाराज व्याघ्रः समभवत् तदा॥
en: Indeed, from that time, O king, the transformed tiger lived, living upon the other animals of the forest, like a true king of beasts.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा राजशार्दूल गदामादाय वीर्यवान्।॥ अभ्यतिष्ठत युद्धाय शक्रो वृत्रमिवाह्वयन्। कुरुराजस्य शान्तनोः
en: Having said these words, ( foremost of kings, the highly energetic, Vrikodara armed with mace, stood for fight, like Shakra challenging the Asura Vritra.

sa: सर्वात्मा सर्ववित् सर्वः सर्वज्ञः सर्वभावनः॥ यं देवं देवकी देवी वसुदेवादजीजनत्।
en: Like two sticks creating a blazing fire, you have been born of the divine Devaki and Vasudeva for the protection of Brahma on Earth.

sa: शयाना ये परा सर्वे मृदूनि शयनानि च। विपन्नास्तेऽद्यं वसुधां विवृतामधिशेरते॥
en: All of them deserve sleeping on soft and clean beds, But alas, in a distressful condition they are sleeping to-day on the naked ground.

sa: तेनैवत्व धृतिमता श्रीमता चाभिसत्कृतः॥ प्रमाणं सर्वभूतेषु गत्वा च ग्रहणं महत्।
en: Honoured by Janaka enducd with intelligence and prosperity, you will certainly become the right hand of that king and enjoy the confidence of all.

sa: विहितान्नाः प्रजास्तास्तु जग्मुः सृष्टा यथागतम्। ततो ववृधिरे राजन् प्रीतिमत्यः स्वयोनिषु॥
en: Their means of sustenance having been thus settled the newly created creatures all went away where they liked, and cheerfully multiplied their respective species.

sa: यं पुरा पर्युपासीना रमयन्ति वरस्त्रियः। तं वीरशयने सुप्तं रमयन्त्यशिवाः शिवाः॥
en: Inauspicious jackals are now pleasing that prince sleeping on the hero's bed, who was formerly counted by the fairest of ladies sitting round him.

sa: गवां शतसहस्रं तु पात्रेभ्यः प्रतिपादयेत्। ब्रह्महा विप्रमुच्येत सर्वपापेभ्य एव च।॥
en: By giving away a hundred thousand kine to deserving persons, one becomes cleansed of the sin of Brahmanicide as also of all other sins.

sa: परिवादं ब्रुवाणो हि दुरात्मा वै महाजने। प्रकाशयति दोषांस्तु सर्पः फणमिवोच्छ्रितम्॥
en: That wicked wretch, who mentions the faults of a high-souled person, really displays his own evil nature even as a snake shows his hood.

sa: यदिदं पाण्डवैः सर्वैस्तव चित्तानुरोधिभिः। कथं कुलक्षयो न स्यात्तथा क्षत्रस्य भारत॥
en: Out of respect for you the Pandavas had tried to prevent the destruction of their family and the extermination of the Kshatriyas, O Bharata.

sa: ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च राजन्या लोकान् रक्षन्ति धर्मतः। स्थावरं जगमं चैव क्षत्रियेभ्यः सनातनम्॥
en: After the Brahmanas, the Kshatriyas are piously protecting all creatures. The universe, consisting of mobile and immobile creatures, is kept awake by the Kshatriyas.

sa: अनृतेनोपवर्ती चेत् प्रतिरोद्धा गुरोस्तथा। उपाहृत्य प्रियं तस्मै तस्मात् पापात् प्रमुच्यते॥
en: One who utters untruth before one's preceptor or acts against his wishes, becomes freed of that sin by doing something agreeable to one's preceptor.

sa: आत्मानं सर्वतो रक्षन् राजन् रक्षस्व मेदिनीम्। आत्ममूलमिदं सर्वमाहुवै विदुषो जनाः॥
en: Guarding his own self first from every one, the king should protect the Earth. Men of knowledge have said that everything originate from self.

sa: तिर्यग्योनिवधं कृत्वा दुमाश्छित्त्वेतरान् बहून्। त्रिरात्रं वायुभक्षः स्यात् कर्म च प्रथयन्नरः॥
en: Having killed a bird or an animal, or cut down living trees, a person should declare his sin publicly and fast for three nights.

sa: रसातलगतः श्रीमाननन्तो भगवान् विभुः। जगद् धारयते कृत्स्नं तस्मै वीर्यात्मने नमः।७६॥
en: Assuming the form of the beautiful, illustrious, and powerful Ananta in the neither region, you uphold the universe. Salutations to your form of power.

sa: अथ सम्प्रतिपत्तिज्ञः प्राब्रवीद् दीर्घदर्शिनम्। प्राप्ते काले न मे किंचिन्यायतः परिहास्यते॥
en: Then the other fish, who had presence of mind, said to his idle companion,-When the time for anything comes, I take the necessary precautions.

sa: तवैव नाम्ना प्रथितः पुत्रस्ते लोकभावनः॥ सारस्वत इति ख्यातो भविष्यति महातपाः।
en: This your son, capable of creating new worlds, will pass after thy name! That great ascetic will be known by the name of Sarasvat!

sa: तानुवाच ततो देवो विहितस्तत्र वै मया। यथास्य भविता मृत्युरचिरेणेति भारत॥
en: The eternal god answered them, O Bharata, saying,-I have already arranged the means by which the death of this Rakshasa may soon be encompassed.

sa: आदाय बलिषड्भागं यो राष्ट्र नाभिरक्षति। प्रतिगृह्णाति तत् पापं चतुथाङ्खशेन भूमिपः॥
en: That king, who, realising his tribute of a sixth, does not protect his kingdom, shares a fourth part of the sins of his kingdom.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तो भगवता धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। चिन्तयित्वा मुहूर्तेन प्रत्युवाच तपोधनम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said This accosted by the holy Rishi, king Yudhishthira the just, having thought for a short time, said these words to the sage.

sa: यं स्म पाण्डवसंत्रासान्मम पुत्रा महारथाः। प्रायुध्यन्त पुरस्कृत्य मातङ्गा इव यूथपम्॥
en: My sons, those powerful car-warriors, from fear of the Pandavas, fought, fled by Karna, like a heart of elephants with its leader standing first.

sa: नाधर्मश्चरितो राजन् सद्यः फलति गौरिव॥ मूलानि च प्रशाखाश्च दहन् समधिगच्छति।
en: Like a cow, O king, sin, when perpetrated, does not yield immediate fruits. That sin destroys the perpetrator after consuming his roots and branches.

sa: ते च्छन्नाः समरे तेन पाण्डवानां महारथाः॥ नाशक्नुवंस्तदा युद्धे प्रत्युद्यातुं महारथम्।
en: Thus covered by Shalya in that battle the great car-warriors of the Pandavas could not proceed against that great hero for fighting with him.

sa: एवं श्रुत्वा निराक्रम्य दीर्घदर्शी महामतिः। जगाम स्रोतसा तेन गम्भीरं सलिलाशयम्॥
en: Hearing the replies of his two companions, the one, which had fore-thought and intelligence, immediately started by a current and reached another deep lake.

sa: आजिघ्रन पेशलान् गन्धान फुल्लानां वृक्षवीरुधाम्। नानारूपान् वने पश्यन् रमणीयान् वनौकसः॥
en: I shall enjoy the fragrance of trees and creepers, covered with flowers and see various kinds of charining products that grow in the forest.

sa: प्रेतकृत्यं च यतते कृपी कृपणमातुरा। हतस्य समरे भर्तुः सुकुमारी यशस्विनी॥
en: The illustrious and delicate Kripi, depressed and Sorrow-stricken, is trying to perform the last rites on the body of her husband killed in battle.

sa: यदुद्यम्य महत् कृत्यं भयादपि निवर्तते। अशक्तश्चैव तत् कर्तु कर्म शक्तिबलादिह॥
en: By using my skill and power, I am unable to achieve that which I have promised? Human exertion is never more powerful than destiny.

sa: भूत्वा हि जगतो नाथो ह्यनाथ इव मे सुतः। गदामुद्यम्य यो याति किमन्यद् भागधेयतः॥ अहो दुःखं महत् प्राप्तं पुत्रेण मम संजय। एवमुक्त्वा स दुःखार्तो विरराम जनाधिपः॥
en: My poor son, who had before been the lord of the universe, was now himself without help! Alas, he had, then, to proceed on foot, shouldering his mace! What can it be but Destiny? Alas, O Sanjaya, great was the grief that was felt by my son now! 'Having uttered these words, the king afflicted with great sorrow became silent.

sa: भूमिवर्जं धनं राजा जित्वा राजन् महाहवे। अपि चान्नौषधीः शश्वदाजहार प्रतर्दनः॥
en: Defeating his enemies in great battle, King Pratardana took all their wealth, including their very grain and medicinal herbs, but left their land untouched.

sa: संजय उवाच तं शयानं कुरुश्रेष्ठं ततो भरतसत्तम। अश्वत्थामा समालोक्य करुणं पर्यदेवयत्॥ आहुस्त्वां राजशार्दूल मुख्यं सर्वधनुष्यताम्। धनाध्यक्षोपमं युद्धे शिष्यं संकर्षणस्य च॥
en: Sanjaya said Seeing that Kuru's Chief lying on the earth Ashvatthaman, O best of the Bharatas, bewailed thus piteously,-O foremost of kings, all people recognised you as the best of all bowmen! People also said that in mace fight you, a disciple of Shankarshana, were like Kuvera himself.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच निदेशाद् भवतः पूर्वं वने विचरता मया। तीर्थयात्राप्रसङ्गेन सम्प्राप्तोऽयमनुग्रहः॥
en: Yudhishthira said While at your behest I wandered in the foremost, I obtained this boon at the time of sojourning to the sacred places!

sa: सुमित्रो नाम राजर्षिर्हहयो मृगयां गतः। ससार स मृगं विद्ध्वा बाणेनानतपर्वणा॥
en: A royal sage of the Haihaya family, Sumitra by namre, went a hunting. Having pierced a deer with a straight arrow, he pursued it.

sa: अमुं च लोकं त्वयि भीष्म याते ज्ञानानि नंक्ष्यन्त्यखिलेन वीर। अतस्तु सर्वे त्वयि संन्निकर्ष समागता धर्मविवेचनाय॥
en: When you, O Bhishma, will leave this world all knowledge, O hero, will end with you. It is, therefore, that all these persons, assembled together, have approached you for listening to discourses on duty and morality.

sa: विश्रम्यैकां निशामद्य भवद्भिः सहितो रणे। प्रतियोत्स्याम्यहं शत्रूञ्चो न मेऽस्त्यत्र संशयः॥
en: Taking rest for this one night, I shall in the morning join you and fight with the enemy. There is no doubt about it.

sa: मात्रापित्रोश्च ये वृत्तिं वर्तन्ते धर्मकोविदाः। वर्जयन्ति दिवा स्वजं दुर्गाण्यतितरन्ति ते॥
en: Those persons, who, conversant with duties, treat their parents properly, those, who do not sleep during the day, succeed in getting over all difficulties.

sa: स ते धर्मरहस्येषु संशयान् मनसि स्थितान्। छेत्ता भागीरथीपुत्रः सर्वज्ञः सर्वधर्मवित्॥
en: Conversant with all duties and endued with universal knowledge that son of Bhagirathi will remove all your doubts regarding the difficult subjects of duties.

sa: अथास्य पादौ जग्राह भीष्मश्चापि ननन्द तम्। मूर्ध्नि चैनमुपाघ्राय निषीदेत्यब्रवीत् तदा॥
en: He seized the feet of Bhishma who in return cheered him with affectionate words. Smelling his head, Bhishma asked Yudhishthira to take his seat.

sa: सोऽहं निर्जित्य समरे विजयं सहकेशवम्॥ संधास्ये धर्मपुत्रेण पश्चादिति च सोऽब्रवीत्।
en: Having defeated Arjuna with Keshava, therefore, in battle, I will afterwards make peace with Dharma's son! These were his words as we have heard.

sa: एते हि पार्थिवाः सर्वे शीलवन्तो दयान्विताः। अतस्तेषां गुणक्रीता वसुधा स्वयमागता॥
en: All these kings were endued with mercy and virtuous conduct. Therefore, the Earth came to them at their will, won over by their virtues!

sa: दण्डनीत्यां प्रणीतायां सर्वे सिद्ध्यन्त्युपक्रमाः। कौन्तेय सर्वभूतानां तत्र मे नास्ति संशयः॥
en: O son of Kunti, I am sure that the acts of all creatures become successful only when the policy of chastisement is properly applied.

sa: यदिदं दृश्यते वित्तं पृथिव्यामिह किंचन। ममेदं स्यान्ममेदं स्यादित्येवं काक्षते जनः॥
en: With respect to wealth which is seen in this world, every one fights with every one else, saying,-This shall be mine.-This shall be imine.

sa: य एव देवा हन्तारस्ताँल्लोकोऽर्चयते भृशम्। हन्ता रुद्रस्तथा स्कन्दः शक्रोऽग्निवरुणो यमः॥
en: Those amongst the gods that are giving to killing others are worshipped much more by inen. Rudra, Skanda, Shakra, Agni, Varuna, are all destroyers.

sa: याच तत्र स्त्रियः काश्चिद्धतवीरा हतात्मजाः॥ सर्वास्ताः कौरवो राजा सम्पूज्यापालयद् घृणी।
en: The kind Kuru king honoured and protected all those ladies also who had, for the battle, been deprived of their heroic husbands and sons.

sa: यं च व्यक्तस्थमव्यक्तं विचिन्वन्ति महर्षयः। क्षेत्रे क्षेत्रज्ञमासीनं तस्मै क्षेत्रात्मने नमः॥
en: The great Rishis seek your unmanifest self within the manifest. Called Kshetrajna, you sit in Kshetra. Salutations to you in your form of Kshetra.

sa: यच्च मामात्थ गाड्नेय बाणघातरूज प्रति। गृहाणात्र वरं भीष्म मत्प्रसादकृतं प्रभो॥
en: Regarding what you have said about the pain of wounds, receive, O Bhishma, this boon what I grant you, O powerful one, from favour.

sa: तां नावमिव पर्यस्ता वातधूतां महार्णवे। तव सेनां महाराज सव्यसाची व्यकम्पयत्॥
en: Savyasachin, O monarch, made your army tremble and reel like a boat exposed to danger by a storm on the bosom of the ocean.

sa: न सा विजानाति रणात् कदाचिद् विनिवर्तितुम्॥ विष्णुर्ददौ वैजयन्ती मालां बलविवर्धिनीम्।
en: Vishnu Gave him a triumphal garland that increases the power of the wearer. Uma gave him two pieces of cloth, effulgent like the sun.

sa: यथोक्तमेतद् सचनं प्रागेव मनुना पुरा। यन्मयोक्तं मनुष्येन्द्र ब्रह्मणो वचनं महत्॥
en: These words, that I have said, were, o king, first uttered in days of yore by Manu. They represent the great words of Brahmana.

sa: तत् सैन्यं भरतश्रेष्ठ मुहूर्तेन महात्मभिः। अवध्यत रणं प्राप्य त्रातारं नाभ्यविन्दत॥
en: That army, O Bharata chief, as it came to battle, was in no time killed by those great warriors, for it had no protector.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तूष्णीभूतं तु राजानं शोचमानं युधिष्ठिरम्। तपस्वी धर्मतत्त्वज्ञः कृष्णद्वैपायनोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana saidDvaipayana-Vyasa, that great ascetic conversant with the truths of religion, spoke again to king Yudhishthira, who still remained silent and plunged in grief.

sa: प्रजानामायुषो ह्रासं विज्ञाय भगवाच्छिवः। संचिक्षेप ततः शास्त्रं महास्त्रं ब्रह्मणा कृतम्॥
en: In view, however, of the gradual decrease of the span of human existence, the divine Shiva abridged that highly important science compiled by Brahman.

sa: मा स्मैनं प्रत्युदीक्षेथा मा चैनमभिभाषथाः। रुदन्ती पार्थिवं दृष्ट्वा जगत्यां शोकलालसा॥
en: Do not look at him, nor speak to him ought. Do you on beholding the lord of the earth, overwhelmed with grief, weep only.

sa: अवश्यं विनशिष्यन्ति सर्वे रावण राक्षसाः। वेषां त्वं कर्कशो राजा दुर्बुद्धिरजितेन्द्रियः॥
en: O Rāvana, surely shall all the Räkşasas meet with death, who have such a stupid, harsh and lustful person like you for their king.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा वचनं सूतं सान्त्वयित्वा पुनः पुनः। गुहं वचनमक्लीबो रामो हेतुमदब्रवीत्॥
en: Having said this to the charioteer and consoled him again and again, the energetic Rāma spoke to Guha the following words fraught with reason.

sa: स मैथिली पुनर्वाक्यं बभाषे वाक्यकोविदः। नोन्मत्तया श्रुतौ मन्ये मम वीर्यपराक्रमौ॥
en: Thereupon, that one skilled in speech again spake to Maithili, Methinks you have run mad. Have you not heard of my valour and prowess?

sa: वीर केसरिणः पुत्र वेगवन् मारुतात्मज॥ ज्ञातीनां विपुलः शोकस्त्वया तात प्रणाशितः।
en: O hero! O son of Kesari! O offspring of the Wind! the huge sorrow of your kindred has, my child, been destroyed by you.

sa: ततो रोषपरीताङ्गो वाली स कनकप्रभः। उपरक्त इवादित्यः सद्यो निष्प्रभतां गतः॥
en: Thereupon, Vāli, having a golden hue, greatly exercised with wrath, instantly lost the effulgence of his person like to the sun possessed by Rāhu.

sa: समाप्तवनवासानां राज्यस्थानां च नः पुनः। अन्तःपुरे विभूषार्थो मृग एष भविष्यति॥
en: When shall we regain our kingdom after the expire of the term of our banishment, this deer shall beautify the interior of our palace.

sa: स तत् कबन्धः प्रतिपद्य रूपं वृतः श्रिया भास्वरसर्वदेहः। निदर्शयन् राममवेक्ष्य स्वस्थः सख्यं कुरुष्वेति तदाभ्युवाच ॥
en: Regaining his pristine beauty and shining in grace and effulgence that Kabandha, who was on the sky, fixing his looks upon Rāma, and pointing out to him his way, said Do you make friends with (Sugrīva).

sa: त्रयोदशोऽयं दिवसः पितुर्वृत्तस्य ते विभो। सावशेषास्थिनिचये किमिह त्वं विलम्बसे ॥
en: O Lord this is the thirteenth day since the cremation of your sire. Why did you delay, when you have to collect the bones?

sa: स कालं परिसंख्याय सीतायाः परिमार्गणे। कृतार्थः समयं कृत्वा दुर्मति ववुध्यते॥
en: Having appointed the time time to institute enquiries about Sītā, that wicked-minded one has now forgot it on the accession of his new dignity.

sa: नाराजके जनपदे यज्ञशीला द्विजातयः। सत्राण्यन्वासते दान्ता ब्राह्मणाः संशितव्रताः॥ नाराजके जनपदे महायज्ञेषु यज्वनः। ब्राह्मणा वसुसम्पूर्णा विसृजन्त्याप्तदक्षिणाः॥
en: In a kingless country, the twice-born ones do not celebrate sacrifices. In a kingless country, in mighty sacrifices wealthy Brāhmaṇas do not confer (on the officiating priests) the Dakșiņās (which they receive according to the ordinance).

sa: अर्थिनामुपपन्नानां पूर्वं चाप्युपकारिणाम्। आशां संश्रुत्य यो हन्ति स लोके पुरुषाधमः॥
en: And do you tell him-'He, who breaks his promise made to a powerful benefactor who solicits his favour, is regarded by people as vile.

sa: विचितं तु ततः सर्वं सर्वे ते काननौकसः॥ अन्यदेवापरं घोरं विविशुर्गिरिगह्वरम्।
en: And when they had satisfied themselves that the cave had been searched all through, the dwellers of the woods entered another fearful mountain cavern.

sa: राघवस्य च ते कार्यं कर्तव्यमविशङ्कया। स्यादधर्मो ह्यकरणे त्वां च हिंस्यादमानितः॥
en: It behoveth you to perform Rāghava's service fearlessly or else you shall be visited with sin: on his being insulted you shall be injured.

sa: विष्णोः पदं प्रेक्ष्यमाणा विपाशां चापि शाल्मलीम्। नदीर्वापीतटाकानि पल्वलानि सरांसि च॥ पश्यन्तो विविधांश्चापि सिंहान् व्याघ्रान् मृगान् द्विपान्। ययुः पथातिमहता शासनं भर्तुरीप्सवः॥
en: There seeing the foot-print of Visnu, they desirous of doing the bidding of their master, proceeded a long way, viewing the Vipasa and the Salmali and rivers and tanks and pools and ponds and sheets of water and various kinds of lions and tigers and deer and elephants.

sa: भरतो नाम कैकेय्यां जज्ञे सत्यपराक्रमः। साक्षाद् विष्णोश्चतुर्भागः सर्वैः समुदितो गुणैः॥
en: Then was born of Kaikeyī, named Bharata, having truth for prowess, endowed with all the virtues, and representing the very fourth part of Visnu.

sa: रावणं सगणं हत्वा परितोष्यात्मपौरुषम्। तथास्मि कर्ता नचिराद् यथा प्रीतो भविष्यसि॥
en: Slaying Rāvaņa with his hosts, and putting forth my manliness capable of pleasing others, I will speedily act so that you mayst be pleased.

sa: भवन्तः प्रत्ययं प्राप्ता नीतिमार्गविशारदाः। हितेष्वभिरता भर्तुर्निसृष्टाः सर्वकर्मसु॥ कर्मस्वप्रतिमाः सर्वे दिक्षु विश्रुतपौरुषाः। मां पुरस्कृत्य निर्याताः पिङ्गाक्षप्रतिचोदिताः॥ इदानीमकृतार्थानां मर्तव्यं नात्र संशयः। हरिराजस्य संदेशमकृत्वा कः सुखी भवेत्॥ अस्मिन्नतीते काले तु सुग्रीवेण कृते स्वयम्। प्रायोपवेशनं युक्तं सर्वेषां च वनौकसाम्॥
en: Having received the orders (of the king), you, conversant with polity, engaged in the welfare of your master, expert in every work, incomparable in execution, and renowned in every quarter, have come out, commanded by the lord of monkeys. Now, having failed to attain our object, we shall meet with death. There is no doubt whatever about this. Who, having been unsuccessful in doing the mandate of the king of monkeys, enjoyeth ease? Now all the rangers of the forest should fast for death.

sa: भविष्यन्ति वने यानि तपोविघ्नकराणि ते। रथेन प्रतिबाधिष्ये तानि सर्वाणि राघव॥
en: I shall, O Rāghava, by means of this car, withstand all those impediments that shall present themselves against your ascetic austerities in the forest.

sa: राजा सर्वस्य लोकस्य महेन्द्रवरुणोपमः॥ लोकानां च हिते युक्तो रामो दशरथात्मजः।
en: Daśaratha's son Rāma is the lord of all men like to Mahendra and Varuņa. He is ever engaged in the welfare of all men.

sa: इयं शय्या मम भ्रातुरिदमावर्तितं शुभम्। स्थण्डिले कदिने सर्वं गात्रैर्विमृदितं तृणम्॥
en: This was the bed of my brother; on this hard spot did he turn his lovely limbs, and this grass was pressed by them.

sa: तस्यासीनं नगस्याग्रे मलयस्य महौजसम्॥ द्रक्ष्यथादित्यसंकाशमगस्त्यमृषिसत्तमम्।
en: (There) you will see that foremost of saints, Agastya, resembling the sun.

sa: मन्त्रिभिस्त्वं यथोद्दिष्टं चतुर्भिस्त्रिभिरेव वा। कच्चित् समस्तैर्व्यस्तैश्च मन्त्रं मन्त्रयसे बुध ॥
en: And, O wise one, do you, as laid down in the ordinance, take counsel, severally and in a body with three or four men?

sa: स रावणवचः श्रुत्वा मारीचो राक्षसस्तदा॥ मृगो भूत्वाऽऽश्रमद्वारि रामस्य विचचार ह।
en: Hearing the words of Rāvaņa, the Rāksasa Mārīca assuming the wonderful shape of a (golden) deer began to range at large before Rama's hermitage.

sa: नास्यापराधं पश्यामि नापि दोषं तथाविधम्। येन निर्वास्यते राष्ट्राद् वनवासाय राघवः॥
en: I do not see any such fault or sin in Rāma that he should be banished from the kingdom to range in the wood.

sa: अकर्णधारा पृथिवी शून्येव प्रतिभाति मे। गते दशरथे स्वर्गं रामे चारण्यमाश्रिते॥
en: The Earth without her helmsman seems to me quite empty, on Dasaratha having ascended the celestial regions and Rāma taken refuge in the wilderness.

sa: समक्षं तव सौमित्रे प्राणांस्त्यक्ष्याम्यसंशयम्॥ रामं बिना क्षणमपि नैव जीवामि भूतले।
en: I shall renounce my life before you, therefore, O Laksmana; without Rāma I shall not maintain my being for a moment on this earth.

sa: मणिप्रदानं सीताया वृक्षभङ्ग तथैव च। राक्षसीविद्रवं चैव किंकराणां निबर्हणम् ॥
en: Sīta's handing a gem to Hanumān; and the breaking down of trees; and the fight of the Rakasasis, and the slaughter of the salves.

sa: एवमेतन्मया दृष्टमिमां रात्रिं भयावहाम्। अहं रामोऽथवा राजा लक्ष्मणो वा मरिष्यति॥
en: This was the dream that I saw this terrible night. Either I, or Rama, or the king, or Lakşmaņa is to breathe our last.

sa: ततस्ते वानराः श्रुत्वा गिरं मुनिसमीरिताम्। निश्चक्रमुर्वनात् तस्मात् तान् दृष्ट्वा बालिरब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing those words of the saint, the monkey herd issued out (of the forest). And beholding them (coming out of the forest) Vāli spoke.

sa: मुक्तामणि सुवर्णानि वस्त्राण्याभरणानि च॥ यद् यदिच्छेत् तदैवास्या देयं मच्छन्दतो यथा।
en: And I command that, should she ask for pearls, or rubies, or gold, or apparel, or ornaments, the same should be rendered to her.

sa: यो हि कालव्यतीतेषु मित्रकार्येषु वर्तते। स कृत्वा महतोऽप्यान्न मित्रार्थेन युज्यते॥
en: He, who engage in his friend's service after the proper season is over, does nothing to his well-being, though he performs a great thing.

sa: नहि मे जीवमानस्य नयिष्यसि शुभामिमाम्। सीतां कमलपत्राक्षी रामस्य महिषीं प्रियाम्॥
en: Myself drawing my breath you shall not be able to carry away this beloved queen of Rāma, the pure-natured Sitä having eyes resembling lotuses.

sa: इत्युक्तो लक्ष्मणस्तस्या क्रुद्धो रामस्य पश्यतः। उद्धृत्य खङ्ग चिच्छेद कर्णनासे महाबलः॥
en: Thus desired the exceedingly strong Laksmana, fired with wrath, taking out his sword, in the sight of Rāma, cut off her nose and ears.

sa: वनं गते धर्मरते रामे रमयतां वरे। कौसल्या रुदती चार्ता भर्तारमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: On that foremost of those capable of charming people, the righteous Rāma, repairing to the forest, Kausalyā crying in grief said to her husband.

sa: तयोस्तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रहस्य मुनिपुङ्गवः। अब्रवीच्छ्रयतां राम यस्यायं पूर्वं आश्रमः॥
en: At those words of theirs, that foremost of ascetics, smiling, said, Hear, O Rama, as to whom the asylum has belonged in time past.

sa: सन्ति मे कुशला वैद्यास्त्वभितुष्टाश्च सर्वशः॥ सुखितां त्वां करिष्यन्ति व्याधिमाचक्ष्व भामिनि।
en: I have skilful physicians whom I have completely satisfied with gifts, they will render you whole. Do you, O angry wench, mention your malady.

sa: स तदा भाषमाणं तु भ्रातरं विप्रघातिनम्। अब्रवीत् प्रहसन् धीमानगस्त्यो मुनिसत्तमः॥
en: And, as that brother of Vātãpi, given to slaughtering Vipras was speaking thus, that foremost of ascetics, the intelligent Agastya, said with a laugh,

sa: कथं ह्यहं प्रतिज्ञाय वनवासमिमं गुरोः। भरतस्य करिष्यामि वचो हित्वा गुरोर्वचः॥
en: How, after having promised to my superior this exile of mine, shall I act up to Bharata's words, setting aside those of my superior?

sa: इदं प्रविष्टा सहसा बिलं तिमिरसंवृताम्। क्षुत्पिपासापरिश्रान्ताः परिखिन्त्राश्च सर्वशः॥ महद् धरण्या विवरं प्रविष्टाः स्म पिपासिताः। इमांस्त्वेवंविधान् भावान् विविधानद्भुतोपमान्॥ दृष्ट्वा वयं प्रव्यथिताः सम्भ्रान्ता नष्टचेतसः। कस्येतै काञ्चना वृक्षास्तरुणादित्यसंनिभाः॥
en: Having rashly entered this cave enveloped in gloom, we have been exercised with hunger and thirst; and are extremely faint. And, having entered this mighty cave underneath the earth, we have become thirsty. And, seeing all these wonderful phenomena, we have become afflicted, and bewildered; and have lost our sense. To whom belong these golden trees resembling the infantine sun;

sa: विजनेऽपि वने सीता वासं प्राप्य गृहेष्विव। विस्रम्भं लभतेऽभीता राम विन्यस्तमानसा॥
en: And even in the lonely woods, Sītā as if remaining at home, having fixed her thoughts on Rāma, is living a life of love.

sa: कुलीनमकुलीनं वा वीरं पुरुषमानिनम्। चारित्रमेव व्याख्याति शुचिं वा यदि वाशुचिम्॥
en: One's character (fashioned according to scripture) shows whether one is high-born or base, heroic or vainly priding himself on his manliness, pure or impure.

sa: श्रुता नु यादृशाः पूर्वं नृपतीनां विनाशने। आकारांस्तानहं सर्वानिह पश्यामि सारथे॥
en: O charioteer, I see around me all those signs which I had heard told as occurring on the occasion of he death of monarchs.

sa: ततो हनूमान् गिरिसंनिकाशः कृताञ्जलिस्तामभिवाद्य वृद्धाम्। पप्रच्छ का त्वं भवनं बिलं च रत्नानि चेमानि वदस्व कस्य॥
en: And-Hanumān like to a hill, bowing down to the old women with joined hands, asked her, saying,-Who are you? And tell me, to whom belong this edifice and the cave as well as all these jewels.

sa: भरतेनाथ संदिष्टा सम्पर्दो न भवेदिति। समन्तात् तस्य शैलस्य सेना वासमकल्पयत्॥
en: Commanded by Bharata, Let not (Rāma's asylum) by trampled by the forces, the army took up its quarters at a distance from the hill.

sa: एवं ब्रुवाणौ काकुत्स्थौ त्वरमाणौ युयुत्सया। सर्वे ते मुनयः प्रीताः प्रशशंसुर्नृपात्मजौ॥
en: Upon the two Kākutsthas' saying this, and finding them prompt for the encounter, those ascetics well-pleased, fell to extolling the sons of the king.

sa: भृत्यानां भरणात् सम्यक् प्रजानां परिपालनात्। अर्थादानाच्च धर्मेण पिता नस्त्रिदिवं गतः॥
en: Having renounced his human frame wasted and worn out with age, our father has attained celestial state, which exists in the regions of Brahma.

sa: राज्यं प्रशासतस्तस्य पितृपैतामहं महत्। अहं सर्वेषु कालेषु प्रणतः प्रेष्यवत् स्थितः॥
en: While he was governing the kingdom which had belonged to his father and grand-father, I, at all times, in humiliation, remained like a servant.

sa: भास्करोदयकालोऽसौ गता भगवती निशा। असौ सुकृष्णो विहगः कोकिलस्तात कूजति॥ बर्हिणानां च निर्घोषः श्रूयते नदतां वने। तराम जाह्नवीं सौम्य शीघ्रगां सागरङ्गमाम्॥
en: This is the time of sunrise: the reverend Night has departed. O child, this gracefully sable-hued bird, the Coel, has began to warble, and I hear the cries of peacocks uttering notes in the woods. O amiable one, we will cross the Jāhnavī, fast rushing to the ocean.

sa: अस्यावामभुजं श्लिष्टा या सा तिष्ठति दुर्मनाः॥ इयं सुमित्रा दुःखार्ता देवी राज्ञश्च मध्यमा। कर्णिकारस्य शाखेव शीर्णपुष्पा वनान्तरे॥ एतस्यास्तौ सुतौ देव्याः कुमारौ देववर्णिनौ। उभौ लक्ष्मणशत्रुघ्नौ वीरौ सत्यपराक्रमौ॥
en: She that stands at her left hand, in dejected guise, is the noble Sumitrā afflicted with sorrow, the second wife of the monarch, like a Karņikāra bough in a forest, with all its blossoms shrivelled up. The sons of this exalted lady are the youthful and heroic Lakşmaņa and ſatrughna, having truth for their prowess, and resembling celestials in shape.

sa: अस्मिन्नेवंगते कार्ये सागरस्य ममैव च। प्रीतिं प्रीतिमनाः कर्तुं त्वमर्हसि महामते॥
en: The time for returning benefits having arrived, O high-souled one, it behove you to afford me and the ocean, satisfaction with a blessed heart.

sa: अतस्तु किं दुःखतरं यदहं जीवितक्षये॥ नहि पश्यामि धर्मज्ञं रामं सत्यपराक्रमम्।
en: What can be an object of greater regret than that I during my last moments cannot behold the righteous Rāma having truth for prowess?

sa: एतस्मिन् निहते कृत्स्नामनुशाधि वसुंधराम्। अद्य पुत्रं हतं संख्ये कैकेयी राज्यकामुका॥ मया पश्येत् सुदुःखार्ता हस्तिभिन्नमिव द्रुमम्।
en: On this one being slain, you will rule the entire earth. To day shall Kaikeyi lusting after the kingdom, with grief behold her son slain in battle by me, like a tree riven by an elephants.

sa: उद्यानानि पुरा भान्ति मत्तप्रमुदितानि च। जनानां रतिसंयोगेष्वत्यन्तगुणवन्ति च॥ तान्येतान्यद्य पश्यामि निरानन्दानि सर्वशः। स्रस्तपर्णैरनुपथं विक्रोशद्भिरिव दुमैः॥
en: Gardens which, frequented by people inebriated with the honey of love, met together for purposes of sport, looked charmingly blooming, I find as utterly void of cheerfulness, with the trees as if lamenting with tremulous leaves.

sa: मनसाऽस्मि गतो यत् त्वां परिष्वज्य यशस्विनि। वीर्यवान् बुद्धिसम्पन्नस्तव पुत्रो भविष्यति॥
en: As, O famous damsel, by embracing the, I have mentally entered into your womb, you shall her a son, intelligent and endued with prowess.

sa: ततस्तत्र समासीनौ नातिदूरे निरीक्ष्य ताम्। न्यग्रोधे सुकृतां शय्यां भेजाते धर्मवत्सलौ॥
en: Then viewing from where they sat at ease their well-laid bed under the banian tree, those virtuous ones (Rāma and Sītā) went to it.

sa: कोन्वस्मिन् साम्प्रतं लोके गुणवान् कश्च वीर्यवान्। धर्मज्ञश्च कृतज्ञश्च सत्यवाक्यो दृढत्नतः॥
en: Who at present in this world is like crowned with qualities, and with prowess, knowing duty, and grateful, and truthful, and firm in vow.

sa: श्रूयते धीमता तात श्रुतिर्गीता यशस्विना। गयेन यजमानेन गयेष्वेव पितृन् प्रति॥
en: O child, we hear that in Gaya, formerly the famous Gaya, engaged in a sacrifice, chanted this Vedic hymn, for pleasing his departed ancestors.

sa: सकलत्रस्य संदेहो नित्यं युक्तस्य राघव। समर्थस्यापि सहितो वासो दुःखमिहाद्य ते॥
en: O Rāghava, although you are vigilant, able, and in all ways capable, it would be unpleasant for you to dwell here now in doubt.

sa: महामेरुप्रतीकाशं मां द्रक्ष्यध्वं प्लवङ्गमाः॥ दिवमावृत्य गच्छन्तं ग्रसमानमिवाम्बरम्। विधमिष्यामि जीमूतान् कम्पयिष्यामि पर्वतान्। सागरं शोषयिष्यामि प्लवमानः समाहितः॥
en: Resembling Mahāmeru, me shall behold, you monkeys, making my way, covering up sky, as if devouring up the heavens. I shall, leaping concentrating my energy, scatter the clouds, shake the I and suck up the ocean.

sa: विसर्जयित्वा स हरीन् सहस्रान् कृतकर्मणः। मेने कृतार्थमात्मानं राघवं च महाबलम्॥
en: Having dismissed the thousands of apes, who had performed their task, he deemed himself as well as the mighty Rāghava as having secured success.

sa: यं यान्तमनुयान्ति स्म पदातिरथकुञ्जराः। स वत्स्यति कथं रामो विजनं वनमाश्रितः॥
en: How is Rāma passing his days in the lone forest, he who when he went out used to be followed by foot-men and elephants?

sa: सम्पन्नं राज्यमिच्छंस्तु व्यक्तं प्राप्याभिषेचनम्। आवां हन्तुं समभ्येति कैकेय्या भरतः सुतः॥
en: Having got himself installed, Kaikeyi's son, Bharata, anxious to render his royalty perfectly safe, is coming hither for the purpose of slaying us both.

sa: तिष्ठेति राजा चुक्रोश याहि याहीति राघवः। सुमन्त्रस्य बभूवात्मा चक्रयोरिव चान्तरा॥
en: The king exclaimed, "Stay,” Rāghava said, "On, On." Sumantra's mind vacillated like that of one placed between two hosts burning to encounter each other.

sa: राघवाय च संन्यासं दत्त्वेमे वरपादुके। राज्यं चेदमयोध्यां च धूतपापो भवाम्यहम्॥
en: And having rendered to Rāghava the trust in the shape of these sandals, this kingdom, and Ayodhyā, I shall be washed form my sin.

sa: ततस्तु ताः प्राश्य तमुत्तमस्त्रियो महीपतेरुत्तमपायसं पृथक्। ऽचिरेण गर्भान् प्रतिपेदिरे तदा॥
en: Then those excellent consorts of the lord of earth, having separately partaken of that choice Pāyasa, shortly bore offspring, resembling fire or the Sun.

sa: समुत्थाने च तदूपं कर्तुकामं समीक्ष्य तम्। उत्स्मयित्वा तु भगवान् वातापिमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: After the Šrāddha ceremony had been over, finding that Bātāpi desirous of assuming the shape of a Rākṣasa the great saint Agastya said smiling.

sa: बलं च तदनाहूतं गजाश्वरथसंकुलम्। प्रययौ भरते याते सर्वे च पुरवासिनः॥
en: And the forces, filled with elephants and horses and cars, although not called, set out on Bharata proceeding, as well as all the citizens.

sa: यया पुत्रश्च भर्ता च त्यक्तावैश्वर्यकारणात्। कं सा परिहरेदन्यं कैकेयी कुलपांसनी॥
en: Whom else will that stainer of her line, Kaikeyī, forsake now, who for the sake of wealth has forsaken her son and her lord?

sa: आरोप्य सीतां प्रथमं संघाटं परिगृह्य तौ ततः प्रतेरतुर्यत्तौ प्रीतौ दशरथात्मजौ॥
en: And first having placed Sītā on the raft, those sons of Daśaratha ascended themselves, and with glad heares began carefully to cross (the stream)..

sa: न खल्वेतन्मयैकेन क्रियते पितृशासनम्। एतैरपि कृतं देवि ये मया परिकीर्तिताः॥
en: It is not I alone who am carrying out my father's command; those whom I have mentioned now, O worshipful one, have done so.

sa: इहोपयात्यसौ रामो यावन्मां नाभिभाषते। निष्ठां नयत तावत् तु ततो माद्रष्टुमर्हति॥
en: Rāma is coming hither. Do you set out for another place, ere he yet addresses me. He is not fit to behold me (now.)

sa: सुदुःखशयितः पूर्वं प्राप्येदं सुखमुत्तमम्। प्राप्तकालं न जानीते विश्वामित्रो यथा मुनिः॥
en: Having lain down miserable before, Sugrīva, now that he has attained this supreme happiness, does not heed his urgent duties, like the ascetic Visvamitra.

sa: आपाते पक्षिसङ्घानां पक्षिराज इव व्रजन्। हनुमान् मेघजालानि प्रकर्षन् मारुतो यथा॥
en: And coursing through the regions of fowls like the monarch of the feathered race, Hanuman, pushing away masses of clouds, resembled the wind himself.

sa: तच्च गङ्गावतरणं त्वया कृतमरिंदम। अनेन च भवान् प्राप्तो धर्मस्यायतनं महत्॥
en: And, O vanquisher of your foes, having brought about Ganga's dissension, you shall from this act of your also attain the regions of Brahma.

sa: पश्य सौम्य नरेन्द्रस्य जनकस्यात्मसम्भवाम्। मम भार्यां शुभाचारां विराधाङ्के प्रवेशिताम् ॥
en: O amiable one, behold the daughter of king Janaka, my wife of pure ways, an illustrious princess brought up in luxury, on Virādha's waist.

sa: सैषा हि मागधी राम वसोस्तस्य महात्मनः। पूर्वाभिचरिता राम सुक्षेत्रा सस्यमालिनी॥
en: And this Mägadhi, O Råma, belongs to the high-souled Vasu, taking, O Rāma, an easterly course, and flowing through fertile fields furnished with corn.

sa: यदसौ मातुलकुले दत्तराज्यः परं सुखी। भरतो वसति भ्रात्रा शत्रुघ्नेन मुदान्वितः॥
en: Bharata, on whom the king has conferred the kingdom, along with his brother Satrughna, is living happily in the house of his maternal uncle.

sa: विवर्धमानो वीर्येण समुद्र इव पर्वणि। हतं मेने तदा राम वसिष्ठमृषिसत्तमम्॥
en: Surcharged with energy, like to the sea during the equinox, he considered, O Rāma, as if that foremost of saints, Vasistha, was already slain.

sa: दग्धस्त्वयाहमवटे न्यायेन रघुनन्दन । वक्ष्यामि तं महावीर यस्तं वेत्स्यति राक्षसम्॥
en: Being burnt by you in the ditch, with due ceremonials, O descendant of Raghu, I shall inention, to you, one who knows that Rāksasa.

sa: यथा त्वया कृतं कर्म भीरुणा लोकगर्हितम्। तस्कराचरितो मार्गो नैष वीरनिषेवितः॥
en: What have been perpetrated by you coward, is blamed by all, and is the way taken recourse to by thieves and not by heroes.

sa: तेषां संवदतां तत्र तपोदीर्पण चक्षुषा ॥ विज्ञाय परमप्रीता मुनयो हर्षमागमन्।
en: As they were conversing thus, the ascetics were highly delighted on discovering them by means of their far-reaching spiritual vision, and they rejoiced greatly.

sa: अथ तौ देशकालज्ञौ राजपुत्रावरिंदमौ। देशे काले च वाक्यज्ञावब्रूतां कौशिकं वचः॥
en: Then those princes, repressors of foes, cognizant of place, and time, and words, thus spoke to Kuśika's son agreeably to time and place, saying,

sa: यथा हि रामो धर्मात्मा तत्कुरुष्व समाहितः। राजस्तिष्ठ स्वसमये भव सत्यप्रतिश्रवः॥
en: And do you, O king, with a composed heart, perform what the virtuous-souled Rāma has ordered you to do and thus fulfil your promise.

sa: धिगस्तु खलु निद्रां तां ययापहतचेतसः। नाद्य पश्यामहे रामं पृथूरस्कं महाभुजम्॥
en: Oh! fie on that sleep through which having been deprived of senses, well shall not to-day behold Rāma of broad chest and mighty arms.

sa: तिष्ठ त्वं हरिशार्दूल मयि विश्रम्य गम्यताम्। तदितं गन्धवत् स्वादु कन्दमूलफलं बहु॥ तदास्वाद्य हरिश्रेष्ठ विश्रान्तोऽथ गमिष्यसि।
en: Do you therefore, O best of monkeys, remain here and take rest. And feasting on these many fragrant and sweet fruits and roots, O foremost of monkeys, do you relieve yourself of the toil and proceed.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा पतितं भूमौ क्षतजा जटायुषम्। अभ्यधावत वैदेही स्वबन्धुमिव दुःखिता॥
en: Beholding him fallen on the ground with his person bathed in blood, Sītā became exceedingly aggrieved and darted towards him like to a friend.

sa: सत्यमेवेश्वरो लोके सत्ये धर्मः सदाश्रितः। सत्यमूलानि सर्वाणि सत्यानास्ति परं पदम्॥
en: In this world, truth is the Lord; in truth is established righteousness. Everything has truth for its basis. No condition is superior to truth.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा च तेनाशु सखीजनसमावृता। गृहीता बलवत् कुब्जा सा तद् गृहमनादयत्॥
en: Having said this, he furiously fell upon the hump backed one surrounded by her maids. Thereupon she with her cries made the chamber resound.

sa: इति ब्रुवन्नात्मसमं सुमन्त्रः सारथिस्तदा। दृष्ट्वा दूरगतं रामं दुःखार्तो रुरुदे चिरम्॥
en: Having said this, the charioteer, Sumantra, seeing Rāma intent upon going to a distant land, wept for a long while in heaviness of heart.
